title: Direct Analysis in Real Time Mass Spectrometry (DART-MS) Study of Amino Acids in the Vacuum Stable Liquids EMI-BF$_4$, EMI-Acetate, DEMA-OTf, DEMA-MsO, and Glycerol
background_knowledge: 该工作位于行星科学、天体生物学与空间分析化学的交叉方向，核心目标是探测地外环境中的有机分子和潜在生物分子。传统液相色谱、毛细管电泳或溶液化学分析常依赖液体溶剂作为工作流体，但多数常规溶剂在太空真空环境中会挥发、沸腾或冻结，难以长期稳定保存，且会显著增加航天器的质量、复杂度与成本。离子液体是一类熔点接近或低于室温的熔盐，蒸气压极低、热稳定性和电化学窗口较好，因而被视为真空稳定溶剂，也被研究用于航天器电推进工质；甘油则具有高沸点、低蒸气压、强极性和良好溶解能力，可作为液相基质。DART-MS（Direct Analysis in Real Time mass spectrometry）是一种常压电离质谱技术，利用激发态氦原子等活性物种对样品进行解吸和电离，可快速筛查复杂基质中的小分子，几乎不需样品前处理。其检测能力受分析物挥发性、质子亲和势、溶剂基质效应、离子抑制和气体温度等因素影响；氨基酸通常极性强、易形成两性离子，在质谱中需要有效解吸和电离，因此溶剂选择与操作温度是关键变量。
contribution: 论文使用 Direct Analysis in Real Time 质谱（DART-MS）作为快速筛选手段，考察组氨酸、甘氨酸、精氨酸、赖氨酸和天冬氨酸在五种真空稳定液体（EMI-BF$_4$、EMI-acetate、DEMA-MsO、DEMA-OTf 和甘油）中的可检测性，氨基酸摩尔分数约为 $5\times10^{-4}$ 至 $10^{-3}$。结果表明，在所有离子液体中，溶剂阳离子主导质谱，除 EMI-BF$_4$ 在 $350$ °C 下出现微弱组氨酸信号（归一化峰强度的中位数约 5%）外，未检测到氨基酸；质子型 DEMA 离子液体并未增强检测，其离子组分反而主导谱图；天冬氨酸在任何液体中均未检出。**在甘油溶液中，组氨酸、甘氨酸、精氨酸和赖氨酸均被检出，且组氨酸常成为主导谱线；因此甘油是所测试液体中最有希望用于有机检测的溶剂，理想 DART 氦气操作温度为 $350$--$400$ °C。** 研究还发现，离子液体中没有明确的水吸收或水相蚀变证据，这对离子液体在航天器电推进中的应用具有参考意义。
summary: The detection of organics and potential biomolecules is an important goal of planetary science and astrobiology spacecraft missions, and many types of analytical chemistry for studying organics depend upon liquid solvents as working fluids. However, most liquids are difficult to maintain in the vacuum of space, complicating their use and increasing spacecraft mass and cost. Here we present a study using Direct Analysis in Real Time mass spectrometry (DART-MS) as a rapid screen for the detectability of histidine, glycine, arginine, lysine, and aspartic acid at mole fractions of about $5\times10^{-4}$ to $10^{-3}$ in five vacuum-stable liquids: EMI-BF$_4$, EMI-acetate, DEMA-MsO, DEMA-OTf, and glycerol. In all of the ionic liquids, the solvent cation dominated the spectra and no amino acid was detected, apart from a weak histidine signal in EMI-BF$_4$ at 350$^\circ$ C (median 5\% of the normalized peak intensity). The protic DEMA ionic liquids did not enhance detection, and their ionic components instead dominated the mass spectra. Aspartic acid was not detected in any liquid. In glycerol solutions, histidine, glycine, arginine, and lysine were all detected, and histidine was frequently a dominant line. We thus find glycerol to be the most promising of the liquids tested for organic detection with an ideal operating DART helium temperature of 350--400 $^\circ$C. We also found no clear evidence of water uptake or aqueous alteration in the ionic liquids, which was a secondary goal relevant to ionic liquid spacecraft electric propulsion.

title: X-rays from Low-mass Active Galaxies in the Galaxy And Mass Assembly (GAMA) Survey
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）是星系中心超大质量黑洞吸积物质时释放巨大能量的现象。标准图像中，黑洞周围形成吸积盘，其紫外/光学辐射可电离宽线区气体并产生宽发射线；吸积盘上方的热冕（corona）通过逆康普顿散射产生硬 X 射线，因而 X 射线是追踪黑洞吸积活动、尤其是被尘埃遮蔽或光学暗弱 AGN 的重要探针。低质量星系中的宽线 AGN 为研究较低质量黑洞、黑洞种子增长以及高红移低质量星系中的 AGN 候选体提供了本地类比。此类天体的多波段辐射受宿主星系恒星形成、X 射线双星和尘埃影响，需联合光学发射线、X 射线谱与中红外诊断。常用观测量包括 X 射线光度、光子指数 $\Gamma$、维里黑洞质量、爱丁顿比 $\lambda_{\rm Edd}$ 以及 UV-to-X-ray 谱斜率 $\alpha_{\rm ox}$；AGN 的 X 射线—光学/中红外标度关系则用于检验辐射机制和选择效应。
contribution: 作者利用 Chandra 对 GAMA 巡天中 Salehirad et al. (2022) 选出的七个低质量星系（$M_\star < 5 \times 10^9\,M_\odot$）宽线 AGN 开展新观测。**七个源中有六个探测到 X 射线，$0.5\text{--}8\,\mathrm{keV}$ 光度覆盖 $\log(L_{0.5\text{--}8\,\mathrm{keV}}/\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}})\approx 40.5$–$43.8$。**这些光度总体高于 X 射线双星群体的预期，且 X 射线位置靠近光学星系核，支持吸积超大质量黑洞是主导辐射源。对四个源的光谱拟合给出光子指数 $\Gamma\approx 1.7$–$2.2$，多数情形下缺乏内禀吸收证据。由维里黑洞质量和硬 X 射线热辐射改正得到的标称爱丁顿比为 $\lambda_{\rm Edd}\approx 0.004$–$1.1$，但不确定性很大；光学示踪量通常给出更高的热辐射光度和爱丁顿比，尤其对未探测到 X 射线的星系。X 射线明亮的源大体符合涉及 H$\alpha$ 与 [O III] 的光学 AGN 标度关系，但多数位于既有 X 射线—中红外关系之下，可能反映宿主星系污染。四个源符合预期的 UV-to-X-ray 谱斜率关系，另三个显示相对 X 射线偏弱。**结果表明低质量星系宽线 AGN 的 X 射线性质多样，并强调多波段诊断对理解黑洞吸积及解释高红移宽线 AGN 候选体的重要性。**
summary: We present new Chandra observations of seven broad-line AGNs in low-mass galaxies ($M_\star < 5 \times 10^9\,M_\odot$) selected from the GAMA sample of Salehirad et al. (2022). X-ray emission is detected in six galaxies, with luminosities spanning $\log(L_{\rm 0.5-8\,keV}/{\rm erg\,s^{-1}})\approx40.5$--43.8. Their X-ray luminosities generally exceed predictions for X-ray binary populations, and their proximity to the optical galaxy nuclei favors accreting massive black holes as the dominant emission source. Spectral fits for four sources yield photon indices $Γ\approx1.7$--2.2, with little evidence for intrinsic absorption in most cases. Virial black hole masses and hard X-ray bolometric corrections imply nominal Eddington ratios $λ_{\rm Edd}\approx0.004$--1.1, although uncertainties are substantial. Optical tracers generally imply higher bolometric luminosities and Eddington ratios, particularly for the X-ray-undetected galaxy. The X-ray-bright sources are broadly consistent with optical AGN scaling relations involving H$α$ and [O III], whereas most lie below the established X-ray--mid-infrared relation, potentially reflecting host-galaxy contamination. Four sources are consistent with the expected UV-to-X-ray spectral slope relation, while three show evidence for relative X-ray weakness. These results reveal diverse X-ray properties among broad-line AGNs in low-mass galaxies and highlight the importance of multiwavelength diagnostics for understanding black hole accretion and interpreting broad-line AGN candidates at high redshift.

title: Revisiting the Missing Baryon Problem: Baryon Redistribution Across Halo Evolution
background_knowledge: 在 ΛCDM 宇宙学框架下，暗物质晕通过引力不稳定性形成，并为重子提供引力势阱；重子以冷而密的纤维状气流或较热的准静态模式进入晕内，随后通过辐射冷却、恒星形成和反馈过程在星系与晕际介质之间循环。宇宙重子分数由大爆炸核合成与宇宙微波背景辐射限制，约为 $\Omega_{\mathrm{b}}/\Omega_{\mathrm{m}} \simeq 0.16$。然而在从矮星系到星系团的几乎全部尺度上，暗物质晕内实测或模拟得到的重子比例都显著低于该宇宙平均值，这被称为晕尺度的重子缺失问题。理解该问题需要同时考虑引力势阱深度、气体冷却效率、超新星与活动星系核反馈，以及晕所处的大尺度环境（纤维状结构、空洞等）；尤其需要追踪晕的组装历史与气体在时间上的再分配，而非仅看单一红移处的静态图像。
contribution: 本文利用 NewCluster 模拟的高空间、质量与时间分辨率，并结合并合树与气体示踪粒子，系统追踪暗物质晕的组装历史及重子在其演化过程中的再分配。作者识别出重子分数演化的**三个不同阶段**：低质量晕中由冷吸积驱动的早期增长阶段、可能由超新星反馈主导的抑制阶段，以及大质量晕中由更深引力势阱和热模式吸积促成的恢复阶段。研究进一步发现，重子分数随红移 $z$ 的变化（尤其在低质量晕中）受**星系际介质热状态**的影响：当周围气体的温度持续高于晕的维里温度 $T_{\mathrm{vir}}$ 后，重子供给受到抑制。此外，固定晕质量下重子分数的弥散与大尺度环境相关，**重子丰富的晕更倾向于靠近纤维状结构**。总体而言，结果表明重子分数演化由**反馈过程与大尺度环境的相互作用共同调控**，因此需要采用时间分辨的视角来理解重子循环。
summary: The baryon fraction provides a fundamental diagnostic of baryonic matter distribution within dark matter halos and the baryon cycle. While its cosmic value is well constrained, the baryon content within halos on nearly all scales is significantly lower than the cosmic mean; this is called the ``missing baryon problem.'' Using the high spatial, mass, and temporal resolutions of the NewCluster simulation, we investigate the baryon fraction evolution by tracing halo assembly histories from merger trees and gas tracer particles. We identify three distinct evolutionary phases: an early growth phase driven by cold accretion in low-mass halos, a suppression phase likely dominated by supernova feedback, and a recovery phase in massive halos enabled by deeper potential wells and hot-mode accretion. We further find that the redshift dependence of baryon fraction, particularly in low-mass halos, is influenced by the thermal state of the intergalactic medium, with suppression emerging after the surrounding gas becomes persistently hotter than the halo virial temperature. In addition, the scatter in baryon fraction at fixed halo mass correlates with the large-scale environment, with baryon-rich halos preferentially residing closer to filamentary structures. Overall, our results highlight that baryon fraction evolution is governed by the interplay between feedback and environment, requiring a time-resolved perspective on the baryon cycle.

title: Efficient Identification and Analysis of Space debris Trails in Time-Domain Astronomy
background_knowledge: 该工作属于时间域天文观测与空间态势感知（Space Situational Awareness, SSA）的交叉方向。宽视场巡天相机在曝光期间会记录到恒星、星系以及沿相对视线快速运动的人造卫星和空间碎片；后者因角运动在图像上形成条状拖影，其长度、方向与亮度分布编码了目标的角速度、轨道和形态信息。随着低轨目标数量快速增长，空间碎片对在轨资产和观测天区构成风险，因此需要从海量巡天图像中自动检测、表征并编目驻留空间目标（Resident Space Objects, RSO）。传统流程常依赖人工检查或针对特定观测条件调参，面临星云、星系、宇宙线、读出噪声和密集星场等干扰；研究范式是将图像分割、几何检测、形态测量与统计筛选串联为可扩展流水线，并以信噪比、长度、方向等可测指标评估检测极限和鲁棒性。
contribution: 论文提出一个自动化的端到端流水线，用于检测和表征人造卫星与空间碎片拖影，以应对轨道碎片快速增长对全球空间资产造成的风险。方法采用多阶段几何方法完成原始图像分割和高精度形态学表征。实验表明，该流水线**在真实巡天环境中表现稳健**，可恢复拖影轮廓，并对积分信噪比 $\mathrm{SNR} \ge 86$ 且长度 $\ge 98$ arcsec 的特征达到可操作探测极限。该无监督框架通过监测 RSO 群体，**有助于全球空间可持续性工作**。
summary: This paper presents an automated end-to-end pipeline to detect and characterize artificial satellites and space debris streaks. As the exponential rise of orbital debris poses an escalating risk to global space assets, providing scalable, real-time tools is a critical contribution to the global Space Situational Awareness (SSA) network. The architecture utilizes a multi-stage geometric approach for raw image segmentation and high-precision morphological characterization. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance in real-world survey environments, successfully recovering streak profiles with an operational detection limit for features with integrated $SNR \ge 86$ and lengths $\ge 98$ arcseconds. This unsupervised framework strengthens global space sustainability efforts by monitoring RSO populations.

title: Black Hole Mass Estimation of a Background Quasar in the Vicinity of the cD Galaxy Holm 15A
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积供能，类星体是其中高光度的一类。其宽发射线来自靠近黑洞的宽线区气体，谱线宽度反映云气速度；在维里化假设下，可由宽线宽度与宽线区半径估算黑洞质量，$M_{\rm BH} \propto R_{\rm BLR} (\Delta V)^2/G$。单历元光谱法进一步利用连续谱或发射线光度与半径—光度关系来估计 $R_{\rm BLR}$，从而由一次光谱得到 $M_{\rm BH}$，但依赖定标关系并具有约 0.3 至 0.5 dex 量级系统不确定度。星系团中心 cD 星系是特殊的大质量椭圆星系，常处于并合增长和密集环境中；投影靠近的点状源可能是星系团成员、前景星或背景 AGN，需用红移和谱线特征判定归属。若一个黑洞被 cD 星系引力束缚，其红移应接近星系团系统红移，而背景类星体则呈现明显更高的宇宙学红移。
contribution: 本工作分析 GTC/OSIRIS 获得的 Abell 85 星系团中心区域光谱，重点研究 cD 星系 Holm 15A 以及距其投影 13.74 角秒的点状 X 射线源 SDSS J004150.75-091824.3。测得该点源红移为 $z=1.56386 \pm 0.00397$，确认其为背景类星体，**排除了它是被 Holm 15A 引力束缚的流浪黑洞的可能性**。随后利用单历元光谱估算该背景类星体中心超大质量黑洞的质量，得到 **$\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot)=8.72 \pm 0.26$**。
summary: This study analyzes spectra from the central region of the galaxy cluster Abell 85 observed with GTC/OSIRIS, focusing on the cD galaxy Holm 15A and the point-like X-ray source SDSS J004150.75-091824.3, projected $13.74\arcsec$ from Holm 15A. For the latter, we found it is a background quasar with a redshift of $1.56386 \pm 0.00397$, ruling out the possibility of it being a rogue BH gravitationally bound to Holm 15A. In addition, using single-epoch spectroscopy, we report that the quasar J004150 hosts a Supermassive Black Hole (SMBH) with a mass of $\log(M_{\text{BH}}/\mathrm{M_{\odot}}) = 8.72 \pm 0.26$.

title: A semi-autonomous multi-agent pipeline for high-energy astrophysics research with enforced provenance and verifiable self-extension
background_knowledge: 高能天体物理研究宇宙中 X 射线、伽马射线、宇宙线等高能辐射与粒子过程，核心对象包括黑洞、中子星、脉冲星、吸积双星、活动星系核、脉冲星风星云与超新星遗迹等。其基本物理图像通常涉及强引力场、相对论性喷流、激波加速、高温等离子体以及强磁场中的辐射机制。观测上依赖空间望远镜进行成像、能谱、时变和偏振测量；数据处理一般从公开档案获取原始观测，经过校准、筛选、事件重建、背景建模、能谱或光变提取，再与物理模型和统计推断比较。X 射线偏振测量是较新的观测窗口，可提供辐射区几何、磁场结构与散射机制的信息，IXPE 是其中的代表性任务。该领域的研究范式高度依赖可复现的数据分析与代码流程；由于结论往往建立在复杂软件链和统计比较之上，数据、工具、参数与数值出处必须可追溯。近年来 LLM 智能体被用于检索文献、处理观测和起草结论，但其可能产生幻觉或在任务压力下编造结果，因此需要来源追踪、自动测试、代码审查与人工把关。
contribution: 论文提出并测试了 **auto_research**，一个半自主多智能体流水线：它从 HEASARC 检索并分析原始高能天体物理数据，并能自行编写所需分析工具。流水线在两个环节实施核验。其一，新工具须通过自动检查，包括重复测试运行、扫描常与编造数值同时出现的措辞，并由不同模型提供方的一个模型进行代码审查；随后由人类决定是否将其提升到可信分支。其二，报告中的数值只有在工具或请求的记录输出中包含它，或报告给出其在被引论文中的位置时，才可通过。作者用 IXPE 数据测试该流水线：在工具包中植入的 65 个缺陷里，**47 个通过自动检查，其中 1 个还通过代码审查**；代码审查同时**拒绝了 69 个正确修改中的 40 个**。在 Cyg X-1 上，流水线复现已发表的 IXPE 结果：**全部 14 个比较量在 $3\sigma$ 内一致，但偏振度低于已发表值**。将较弱模型置于主要角色时，流水线**恢复了 14 个量中的 12 个，并将另外 2 个报告为未测量**。作者还将流水线用于六次观测的偏振稳定性分析、29 次观测中偏振与硬度的关系巡测，以及 Stokes 参数 $q$ 与 $u$ 之间时间延迟的搜索。
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are now applied to astronomical data analysis. They retrieve the literature, reduce observations, and draft conclusions. Under pressure to complete a task, such agents can fabricate results, and the numbers they report may not come from the analysis they ran. We present auto_research, a semi-autonomous multi-agent pipeline that retrieves and analyses raw data from the High Energy Astrophysics Science Archive Research Center (HEASARC) and writes the analysis tools that it needs. We check the work of the agents at two points. A new tool enters the toolkit after it passes automatic checks, including repeated test runs and a scan for phrases that accompany invented values, and a code review by a model from a different provider; a human decides whether to promote it to the trusted branch. A number in a report passes only if a recorded output of a toolkit tool or the request contains it, or if the report gives its location in a cited paper. We test the pipeline with data from the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE). Of 65 defects that we planted in the toolkit, 47 pass the automatic checks, and one passes the code review as well; the review also rejects 40 of 69 correct changes. The pipeline reproduces the published IXPE results for Cyg X-1: all 14 compared quantities agree within 3 sigma, and the polarization degrees are lower than the published values. With weaker models in the main roles, the pipeline recovers 12 of the 14 quantities and reports the other two as not measured. We also used the pipeline for a polarization-stability analysis of six observations, a survey of polarization against hardness in 29 observations, and a search for a time lag between the Stokes parameters q and u.

title: Linear perturbation theory and structure formation in a Horndeski theory of gravity without dark matter
background_knowledge: 现代标准宇宙学以广义相对论和 FLRW 度规为基础，认为宇宙中的密度扰动在引力不稳定性作用下增长，并最终形成星系、星系团及宇宙网。冷暗物质提供主要的引力势阱，重子物质随后落入其中并形成可见结构；在线性区，密度反差 $\delta$ 按增长因子 $D(a)$ 演化，其增长方程由引力理论、背景膨胀和物质组分共同决定。暗能量导致晚期加速膨胀并抑制结构增长。因此，大尺度结构观测既是测量暗物质、暗能量的关键手段，也可用于检验修改引力。Horndeski 理论是一类一般的标量-张量引力理论，包含标量场及其导数项，可改变弱场与宇宙学扰动的演化；可行模型还需满足太阳系等弱场检验。Refracted Gravity（RG）则是一种非相对论替代方案，用依赖重子密度 $\rho$ 的引力介电常数 $\varepsilon(\rho)$ 增强引力，从而在星系和星系团尺度上尝试替代暗物质。
contribution: 本文研究一个不含暗物质的标量-张量 Horndeski 引力模型中的宇宙大尺度结构形成与演化，并要求其在弱场极限下退化为 Refracted Gravity（RG）。作者证明，RG 的引力介电常数 $\varepsilon(\rho)$ 对应 Horndeski 模型中标量场 $\varphi$ 的函数 $G_4(\varphi)$。在平坦、物质主导、均匀且各向同性的宇宙背景演化中，标量场 $\varphi$ 同时驱动宇宙加速膨胀，模型能够重现观测到的 Hubble-Lemaître 参数随红移的演化。随后，作者建立线性扰动理论并研究增长因子方程；结果显示，**该模型无法正确描述大尺度结构**，因为它预测宇宙结构形成启动过晚，仅在红移 **$z \lesssim 1$** 之后才发生。
summary: We study the formation and evolution of the cosmic large-scale structure (LSS) in a scalar-tensor Horndeski theory of gravity without dark matter. We impose that this theory reduces to Refracted Gravity (RG) in the weak-field limit. RG is a non-relativistic theory where the gravitational permittivity $ε(ρ)$, with $ρ$ the baryonic matter density, provides the gravitational boost required to describe both the dynamics of galaxies and galaxy clusters without dark matter. We show that $ε(ρ)$ equals the function $G_4(\varphi)$ of the scalar field $\varphi$ of our Horndeski model. The background evolution of a flat, matter-dominated, homogeneous and isotropic universe shows that $\varphi$ is also responsible for the accelerated expansion of the universe and that the model is capable of reproducing the observed redshift evolution of the Hubble-Lemaître parameter. We finally develop the linear perturbation theory and study the growth factor equation. The model fails to correctly describe the LSS by predicting a late onset of the formation of cosmic structure at redshift $z\lesssim 1$.

title: Measuring the ultraviolet background at $z\simeq3$ from the quasar proximity effect in DESI DR1
background_knowledge: 在宇宙再电离之后，星系际介质（IGM）整体处于高度电离状态，但其中残余的中性氢仍会在类星体光谱中产生莱曼阿尔法（Ly$\alpha$）吸收，形成 Ly$\alpha$ 森林。弥漫于宇宙中的紫外背景辐射场（UVBG）主要由类星体和星系贡献，它决定氢的光致电离率 $ \Gamma_{\mathrm{HI}} $，是理解 IGM 热演化、电离状态以及星系与类星体辐射贡献的关键量。观测上，类星体自身的电离辐射会在其附近额外电离氢，造成 Ly$\alpha$ 吸收亏缺，即类星体邻近效应；原则上可由该效应反推 UVBG。但类星体连续谱难以精确测量，且类星体所在环境往往过密、会增强吸收，并与 UVBG 信号简并，因此需要连续谱重建、统计堆叠、成团性约束和流体动力学模拟校准。
contribution: 论文利用 Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument（DESI）Data Release 1 中 $ 2.75\leq z<3.25 $、静止系 1450 埃绝对星等 $ M_{1450}\leq-25.5 $ 且 Ly$\alpha$ 红侧信噪比不低于 3 的 6,245 个类星体，测量 $ z\simeq3 $ 处的紫外背景。作者基于哈勃空间望远镜光谱训练主成分分析来重建类星体连续谱，并堆叠透射通量轮廓；随后用晕模型拟合堆叠轮廓，该模型同时考虑类星体辐射造成的吸收减弱和类星体周围过密环境造成的吸收增强。环境贡献由独立的类星体成团偏置测量约束，透射轮廓则约束 UVBG。为检验方法，作者用 $ z=3 $ 的 Astrid 流体动力学模拟构造与 DESI 样本光度和噪声性质匹配的模拟光谱，并对模拟光谱与 DESI 数据运行同一分析流程，以检验已知输入光致电离率的恢复并校准最终 UVBG 测量。核心结果为 $ \Gamma_{\mathrm{HI}}=(1.376^{+0.095}_{-0.076})\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1} $（$ z\simeq3 $）；统计误差来自对 DESI 视线的 bootstrap 重采样，另估计系统不确定度为 $ ^{+0.837}_{-0.521}\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1} $。**该工作给出了基于 DESI DR1 类星体邻近效应的 $ z\simeq3 $ 紫外背景氢光致电离率测量，并给出了统计与系统误差评估。**
summary: Ionizing radiation from quasars reduces the abundance of neutral hydrogen in the surrounding intergalactic medium (IGM), suppressing Ly$α$ absorption. This absorption deficit, known as the quasar proximity effect, can be used to measure the ultraviolet background (UVBG). We measure the hydrogen photoionization rate of the UVBG in Data Release 1 of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). Our sample contains 6,245 quasars over $2.75\leq z<3.25$, selected with rest-frame absolute magnitudes at 1450 Angstroms of $M_{1450}\leq-25.5$ and signal-to-noise ratios of at least 3 measured redward of Ly$α$. We reconstruct quasar continua with principal component analysis trained on Hubble Space Telescope spectra and stack the resulting transmitted-flux profiles. We fit the resulting stacked profile with a halo model that accounts for reduced absorption from quasar radiation and enhanced absorption in the surrounding overdense environment. We constrain the environmental contribution using independent measurements of quasar clustering bias, while the transmission profile constrains the UVBG. To validate our method, we construct mock spectra matched to the luminosity and noise properties of our DESI sample using the Astrid hydrodynamical simulation at $z=3$. We apply the same analysis pipeline to the mock spectra and DESI data, testing the recovery of known input photoionization rates and using the results to calibrate the final UVBG measurement. We obtain $Γ_{\mathrm{HI}}=(1.376^{+0.095}_{-0.076})\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ at $z\simeq3$. The statistical errors are obtained by bootstrap resampling the DESI sightlines. We also estimate a systematic uncertainty of $^{+0.837}_{-0.521}\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$.

title: Photometric calibration of the 4m ILMT data
background_knowledge: 时域天文学通过重复成像测量天体亮度随时间的变化；要把探测器计数转换为物理通量或标准星等，必须进行测光定标。测光零点 $ZP$ 将仪器星等与标准星等联系起来，其稳定性直接决定光变曲线的系统误差。超新星和类星体都是重要时域目标：前者用于宇宙学与恒星演化研究，后者反映超大质量黑洞吸积盘及宽线区的变化；类星体混响映射利用连续谱与发射线响应的时间延迟测量黑洞质量，结构函数则统计光变幅度随时间间隔的变化，二者都要求长期、跨历元、可比的测光。ILMT 是 4 米口径的液体镜面巡天望远镜，固定指向天顶，依靠地球自转使天体扫过焦平面，并以 TDI 模式同步转移电荷，从而对天顶条带进行连续观测；它在 SDSS $g'$、$r'$、$i'$ 波段工作。此类观测的定标需处理沿扫描方向的零点变化、大气消光、探测器响应与滤光片透过率等效应。常用做法是选取已有高精度测光的参考星，将其星等变换到目标系统后与仪器星等比较，得到零点及颜色项。
contribution: 论文针对 ILMT 在 TDI 模式下获得的点状源观测，提出并实现了一套专用测光定标流程。该工作利用 ZTF 参考源并与 Pan-STARRS1 星表交叉匹配，沿 ILMT 扫描方向推导稳健的测光零点，从而把仪器计数稳定地归算到标准测光系统。**核心结果是建立了适用于 ILMT TDI 点源数据的测光定标方法，并获得沿扫描方向可靠的零点解**；**该定标使超新星与类星体的光变曲线具有一致性和高精度**，可用于本征光变与长期亮度演化研究、结构函数分析，以及未来类星体混响映射等应用。
summary: The International Liquid Mirror Telescope (ILMT) is a 4-meter survey telescope continuously observing towards the zenith in the SDSS g', r', and i' bands. This survey telescope is designed to detect various astrophysical transients (for example, supernovae) and very faint objects like multiply-imaged quasars and low surface brightness galaxies. Ensuring accurate and stable calibration of supernova (SN) and quasar measurements is essential for studying their intrinsic variability and long-term brightness evolution. In this work, we present a dedicated calibration approach tailored for ILMT point-like object observations obtained in Time Delayed Integration (TDI) mode. Using ZTF reference sources cross-matched with the Pan-STARRS1 catalog, we derive robust photometric zero-points along the ILMT scan. This calibration procedure enables the production of consistent, high-precision SN and quasar light curves, suitable for variability studies, structure-function analysis, and future reverberation-mapping applications.

title: Tidal Evolution of Satellite Dwarf Galaxies. I. Tidal Tracks of Stellar Mass and Structure
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型（ΛCDM）中，结构通过等级成团的方式形成：小尺度暗物质晕先坍缩，随后并合进入更大质量的系统。大质量宿主晕（例如银河系质量的晕）周围会保留大量子晕；如果子晕中形成了恒星，它们就表现为卫星矮星系。卫星一旦被宿主吸积，就会受到宿主引力场的潮汐作用：外部潮汐场在卫星内部产生潮汐力，逐渐剥离外围暗物质和恒星；轨道偏心率、近心点距离、质量浓度和恒星分布紧致度等都会影响剥离效率。观测上，矮星系在光度、有效半径、表面亮度和速度弥散等方面表现出显著的结构多样性，其中一部分可能源于潮汐演化，而非初始条件差异。该领域的研究范式包括高分辨率 $N$-body 模拟与流体模拟、半解析模型，以及用“潮汐轨迹”（tidal tracks）描述卫星的束缚质量、恒星质量、半径和速度弥散等随剩余束缚质量分数演化的经验关系，从而把复杂的轨道历史压缩为可移植的拟合公式，服务于星系形成与演化、暗物质子晕统计以及近邻矮星系观测解释。
contribution: 论文基于 480 组受控的 $N$-body 模拟，构建了由暗物质和恒星组成、绕银河系质量宿主运动的卫星矮星系样本，系统扫描暗物质晕浓度、内区密度斜率、恒星-晕质量比、恒星分布相对晕的紧致度以及恒星 Sérsic 指数等初始结构参数。作者给出一套完整的潮汐轨迹库，即恒星质量、半质量半径、平均表面密度和视线速度弥散随宿主暗物质子晕剩余束缚质量分数演化的关系，并提供简单且准确的拟合函数。结果揭示潮汐轨迹对初始结构的依赖：**恒星分布的紧致度决定暗物质被剥离时恒星质量仍能较长时间保持基本完整的持续时间**；**Sérsic 指数和内区暗物质密度斜率则控制晚期恒星质量损失斜率以及残余天体的收缩或膨胀**。该模拟与经验模型框架可用于跨越大范围前身结构的卫星恒星演化建模，并服务于卫星星系演化的半解析模型。
summary: Satellite dwarf galaxies are reshaped by the tidal field of their host, a process that may account for part of the structural diversity of the observed dwarf population. We study how the stellar component of a satellite responds to tidal stripping using a suite of 480 controlled $N$-body simulations of satellite galaxies consisting of both dark matter (DM) and stars orbiting a Milky-Way-mass host. The simulated dwarfs span a broad range of DM halo structural and stellar-distribution parameters, including halo concentration, inner density slope, stellar-to-halo mass ratio, compactness of the stellar distribution with respect to the halo, as well as the Sérsic index of the stellar profiles. We present a comprehensive library of tidal tracks, namely, the evolution of the stellar mass, half-mass radius, mean surface density, and line-of-sight velocity dispersion, as functions of the bound mass fraction of the hosting DM subhalo, and provide simple and accurate fitting functions. We also identify the dependence of tidal tracks on key factors in the initial structural conditions. Notably, stellar compactness determines the duration over which the stellar mass remains relatively intact while the surrounding DM is being stripped. The Sérsic index and inner DM slope, in turn, govern the late-stage stellar mass-loss slope and the contraction or expansion of the remnant. Our simulations and empirical models provide a framework for modelling the stellar evolution of satellites across a broad range of progenitor structures, useful for semi-analytical models of satellite galaxy evolution.

title: Photon arrival time lags in 3D radiative transfer with SKIRT
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）中心的超大质量黑洞吸积物质，会在最内区产生强烈的 X 射线连续谱；这些光子向外传播，并被周围较冷的气体与尘埃（如吸积盘外区、宽线区、尘埃环）重新处理。光电吸收后伴随的荧光发射和自由电子康普顿散射等过程共同塑造出反射谱。其中 Fe K$\alpha$ 荧光线（静止系约 6.4 keV，位置随电离态略有偏移）携带关于几何结构、柱密度与电离态的丰富信息。由于被重新处理的光子比直接辐射多走一段路程，它们的到达时间会产生延迟 $\tau \approx s/c$（$s$ 为额外路径长度），延迟量级对应结构尺度（1 光日约 $2.6\times10^{14}$ cm）。对连续谱与谱线的光变曲线做互相关分析（CCF），可提取峰值延迟与相关峰的宽度，这就是 reverberation mapping 反演辐射区几何的基本原理。真实系统几何复杂，且存在多次散射与吸收，因此需要三维辐射转移进行自洽建模；Monte Carlo 方法通过概率抽样追踪大量光子包在三维空间中的传播与相互作用，SKIRT 即为其中广泛使用的公开代码。XRISM 的高分辨率 X 射线光谱仪与未来的 NewAthena 使高精度谱-时序联合分析成为可能。
contribution: 作者在 Monte Carlo 辐射转移代码 SKIRT 中实现了光子到达时间滞后的计算：追踪每个光子包从发射到逃逸所经历的总路径长度，并将其换算为相对直接辐射的到达时间延迟，从而使三维几何下的光谱与 timing 性质能够被自洽建模。该实现首先在简单几何构型下得到验证，随后应用于一个逼真的 AGN 模型。结果表明，模拟能够再现自由电子散射以及光电吸收 ＋ 荧光两种机制所预期的延迟分布及其能量依赖关系。在 AGN 应用中，模型自然产生来自内、外不同结构的分离延迟成分，并给出 Fe K$\alpha$ 荧光线能量依赖的时间滞后；由模拟得到的互相关函数（CCF）**成功恢复了峰值时间延迟及其有限宽度**，该宽度由延展几何与内禀光变共同造成。这一能力为将 XRISM、NewAthena 等高分辨率 X 射线光谱数据与时序信息联合解释提供了可靠框架，并预期广泛用于吸积系统的 reverberation mapping 等研究。
summary: Reprocessed X-ray emission from cold material surrounding compact objects carries critical information about the geometry and physical state of the system. In particular, the Fe K$α$ fluorescence line provides a powerful diagnostic through its spectral and timing properties relative to the direct emission. Interpreting these observables requires self-consistent modelling of radiative transfer (RT) in three-dimensional (3D) space. We aim to implement photon arrival time lags in SKIRT, a Monte Carlo RT code, thereby enabling self-consistent modelling of both the spectral and timing properties of reprocessed emission in 3D space. We modified the code to accumulate photon path lengths over their lifetimes and convert them into arrival time lags relative to the direct emission. The implementation is validated using simple geometries and then applied to a realistic model of an active galactic nucleus (AGN), for which we compute the time-lag and energy distribution and the cross-correlation functions (CCFs) between the fluorescence line and broad bands. The simulations reproduce the expected time-lag distributions and their energy dependence for both free-electron scattering and the photoelectric absorption $+$ fluorescence. In the AGN application, the model naturally yields distinct lag components from the inner and outer structures, as well as energy-dependent time lags associated with the fluorescence line. The derived CCFs successfully recover both the peak time lag and its finite width, which arise from the extended geometry and intrinsic variability. In X-rays, this capability provides a robust framework for interpreting high-resolution spectroscopic data in conjunction with timing information from current and future missions such as XRISM and NewAthena. A wide range of applications is foreseen, including reverberation mapping studies of accreting systems.

title: The vertical distribution of molecular gas in the fourth quadrant of the Milky Way
background_knowledge: 银河系是以盘为主的旋涡星系，其冷分子气体主要分布在银道面附近的薄盘中，并通过 CO 等示踪谱线被观测。分子气体是恒星形成的原料，其面密度、体密度和激发状态决定了当前及未来恒星形成的潜力。CO 的转动跃迁具有不同临界密度和上能级能量：例如 $^{12}$CO $J=1-0$ 更容易示踪较弥漫、较冷的气体，而 $^{12}$CO $J=3-2$ 需要更高激发，因而更偏向较暖、较密的分子云区域。研究分子云的垂直分布可测量盘的厚度、薄盘与厚盘结构、旋臂与臂间气体的差异，以及银道面弯曲和翘曲等。通常用高斯或类似函数拟合银纬方向剖面，以半高全宽（FWHM）或尺度高度描述气体层厚度；分子气体薄盘典型厚度为几十至约百 pc，而更宽的成分可能来自厚盘、外流或旋臂/臂间叠加。第四象限大致对应 $270^\circ<l<360^\circ$，是银河系内盘和远侧结构研究较少的区域；在旋臂切点附近，视线与旋臂相切，距离信息较易约束，且银纬偏移可近似映射为物理高度 $z \approx d \tan b$，适合研究局部的垂直结构。过往 CO 巡天常受较大波束、非 Nyquist 采样或仅覆盖 $|b|<1^\circ$ 的限制，难以系统刻画分子气体的垂直分布及其与银河系结构、恒星形成的关系。
contribution: 论文使用 APEX 12 m 望远镜的 7 像素 LASMA 接收机，以 $^{12}$CO $J=3-2$ 谱线成图观测第四象限两条旋臂的切点区域：Norma–Outer 臂的 $l=[329^\circ.0,327^\circ.0]$ 和 Scutum–Centaurus 臂的 $l=[310^\circ.0,308^\circ.5]$，覆盖至 $b=[-2^\circ,+2^\circ]$，在切点附近对应 $|z|\sim 200$ pc。观测在 $0.5$ km s$^{-1}$ 速度通道内的噪声约 $0.4$ K（$T_{\mathrm{MB}}$）。对旋臂切点区域的垂直分布采用两个高斯成分拟合，得到**窄成分 FWHM 约 25 pc、宽成分约 100 pc**。作者提出两种解释：二者可能是薄盘的两个子成分（窄成分示踪旋臂，宽成分示踪臂间气体），也可能分别对应薄盘与厚盘，且在 CO 3-2 中测得的厚度小于 CO 1-0，这意味着星际介质密度分布在离银道面较高处具有更陡的梯度。论文还搜索了这两个切点区域的团块并按相对高度分组，发现相对于低相对高度团块（$|z|<50$ pc），中等相对高度团块（$50\ \mathrm{pc}<|z|<100\ \mathrm{pc}$）具有**较低的激发温度和面密度，且分布中的高值较少**；质量分布也呈现类似但仍是暂定性的趋势。
summary: The vertical distribution of molecular gas in the Milky Way disk is poorly studied, especially in the 4th quadrant and the far side of the Galaxy. While surveys over 20 years ago suffered from coarse beam and non-Nyquist sampling, most of the recent surveys are limited to $|b|<1^\circ$ and/or focus on the Northern Galactic plane. We examine the molecular gas's vertical distribution and properties in the fourth quadrant to check the impact of Galactic structure on current star formation. We mapped two arm tangent regions ($l=[329^\circ.0,327^\circ.0]$ for the Norma-Outer arm, and $l=[310^\circ.0,308^\circ.5]$ for the Scutum-Centaurus arm) with the $^{12}$CO 3-2 line using the 7-pixel LASMA receiver of the APEX 12 m telescope, covering up to $b=[-2^\circ,+2^\circ]$ (or $|z|\sim200$ pc near the tangent points). The noise level of the $^{12}$CO 3-2 line is about 0.4 K [$T_{MB}$] in velocity channels of 0.5 km s$^{-1}$. The vertical distribution around the tangent regions of the spiral arm is fitted with two Gaussian components, the narrow one with an FWHM thickness of 25 pc and the wide one of about 100 pc. Two explanations are proposed: they are two sub-components of the thin disk (the narrowest tracing the spiral arm and the other the inter arms components), or they trace both thin and thick disks that show a smaller thickness when observed with CO 3-2 than when observed with CO 1-0. The latter indicates that the density distribution of the interstellar medium exhibits a steeper gradient at larger heights above the plane. Clumps in the two tangent regions are searched and divided into groups by relative height. Compared with the low relative height clumps ($|z|<50$ pc), the median relative height clumps ($50~\mathrm{pc}<|z|<100~\mathrm{pc}$) have lower excitation temperature and surface density, with fewer high values in the distribution. A similar tentative trend is found for the mass.

title: An automated photometric pipeline for measuring the corotation radius of spiral galaxies
background_knowledge: 旋涡星系的旋臂通常被理解为一种密度波（density wave）：它以近似恒定的图案角速度 $\Omega_p$ 在星系盘中刚性旋转，而盘内的恒星与气体则按自身的角速度 $\Omega(R)$ 绕星系中心做较差自转。共转半径 $R_\mathrm{CR}$ 就是满足 $\Omega(R_\mathrm{CR}) = \Omega_p$ 的半径。在该处，旋臂图案的角速度与盘物质的轨道角速度完全一致。这个半径是理解旋涡结构能否长期维持、旋臂如何触发恒星形成，以及棒、旋臂与盘之间如何交换角动量的关键尺度：在共转半径内侧与外侧，盘物质相对旋臂的流动方向相反，因此它与林德布拉德共振（Lindblad resonance）一起界定了星系盘的共振骨架，并深刻影响径向迁移、化学演化与星系的长期演化（secular evolution）。然而，共转半径的测量极其困难。最常用的 Tremaine–Weinberg 方法基于连续性方程，需要二维视向速度场（积分场光谱）以及星系的倾角与方位角信息；其他途径还包括势—密度相位偏移法（potential–density phase shift）与基于颜色梯度的光度方法。颜色梯度法的物理图像是：密度波在气体中传播并触发恒星形成，恒星形成相对于密度波峰存在时间延迟，因此年轻星族（偏蓝的 H II 区）与年老星族（偏红）在方位角上存在系统性相位偏移。该相位差在共转半径两侧发生符号反转。光度法的优势在于只需多波段成像，因此能应用于大规模巡天数据；但以往工作大多依赖人工挑选的少量星系，所用技术与判据也各不相同，样本小、彼此不可比，这使得目前已测得的共转半径数目极少。
contribution: 本文提出了一套自动化光度流程，用于系统测量旋涡星系的共转半径。该流程沿用 Puerari & Dottori 的颜色梯度框架：从去投影的双波段图像中提取方位角亮度剖面，对剖面拟合周期模型，并在年轻星族与年老星族两类示踪物的相位差发生符号变化的半径处识别共转候选者；每个候选点都被赋予自适应不确定度区间，并附带拟合优度指标。作者用跨方法文献汇编对该方法进行基准测试：仅依据已发表的测量结果构建参考集，并对每一种方法（包括本文方法）做留一法评估。在有此类参考的 $90$ 个星系中，该流程**在 $80.0\%$ 的星系中给出了正确的共转半径，找回了这些星系已知共转半径的 $63.6\%$，召回率与纯度的调和平均达到 $0.58$，在所有参与比较的方法中均为最高**。与以往每种方法都只应用于小规模精选样本不同，该流程无需任何预筛选即可运行于整个参考样本，样本量是现有方法的二到六倍。该流程可扩展至大规模巡天，对旋臂模式数保持灵活，并且能在具有复杂旋涡结构的星系中自然地识别出多个共转半径，从而为跨星系种群的盘共振研究提供了统一框架。
summary: The corotation radius R_CR of a spiral galaxy marks the radius where the angular speed of the spiral pattern matches the orbital speed of the disk material. Despite its importance for understanding spiral structure and galaxy evolution, very few galaxies have corotation measurements, often derived using heterogeneous techniques. We present an automated photometric pipeline that identifies corotation radii by tracking the azimuthal phase offset between young and old stellar populations. Building on the color-gradient framework of \citet{Puerari1997}, we extract azimuthal brightness profiles from deprojected dual-band images, fit periodic models to the profiles, and identify corotation candidates at radii where the phase difference between the two stellar tracers changes sign. Each candidate is assigned an adaptive uncertainty interval and reported with a goodness-of-fit metric. We benchmark the method against a cross-method literature compilation, scoring every technique -- including our own -- against a reference built from the published measurements alone and evaluated leave-one-out. Over the $90$ galaxies for which such a reference exists, the pipeline places a correct corotation radius in $80.0\%$ of them, recovers $63.6\%$ of their known corotation radii, and reaches a harmonic mean of recall and purity of $0.58$, the highest values of any method in the comparison. Unlike the published methods, each of which was applied to a small, curated set of galaxies, our pipeline is run on the entire reference sample without any pre-selection, a sample two to six times larger than existing methods. The pipeline is scalable to large surveys, flexible with respect to spiral mode, and naturally recovers multiple corotation radii in galaxies with complex spiral structure, providing a uniform framework for studying disk resonances across diverse galaxy populations.

title: Isophotal signatures of the brightest cluster galaxy - intracluster light transition
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大的引力束缚结构，由暗物质晕、星系成员和高温团内气体组成，其形成与演化遵循等级并合图像。位于星系团势阱中心的最亮团星系（BCG）是质量最大、演化最复杂的星系之一，而团内光（ICL）是弥散在星系团中、未被单个星系束缚的恒星成分，通常被认为来自星系并合、潮汐剥离和冲压剥离等过程。观测上，BCG 与 ICL 的恒星分布常常连续过渡，二者界线并无唯一物理定义，因而依赖所采用的测量方法和阈值；传统分析常通过参数化模型拟合或固定表面亮度阈值来分离 BCG 与 ICL，但不同定义会改变推断的星系团性质。利用表面亮度、椭率、位置角等随半径变化的等照度轮廓，可以研究这一过渡区的结构特征。该领域结合多波段成像、星系团巡天和宇宙学流体模拟，检验恒星分布如何记录星系团的等级组装历史。
contribution: 论文报告 BCG+ICL 系统在表面亮度、椭率和位置角的径向轮廓中普遍存在一个共同的拐点，指示其下垫恒星分布发生了结构转变。作者联合使用 Wendelstein Wide Field Imager 对 $z < 0.1$ 低红移星系团的观测、Hyper Suprime-Cam 对 $0.2 < z < 0.4$ 星系团的深场观测，以及 Horizon-AGN 与 Hydrangea 宇宙学流体模拟，**在 $60$–$85$ kpc 半径处一致识别出该共同拐点**，并将其解释为 BCG+ICL 联合光分布的特征过渡，**可能反映星系团的等级并合组装**。该特征在多个测光波段、不同红移范围和模拟中持续出现，支持其稳健性；作者采用基于二阶导数的自动化方法识别转变，**不依赖参数化分解或任意表面亮度阈值**，为表征 BCG–ICL 过渡提供了具有物理动机且可扩展的框架，并对 LSST 与 Euclid 等未来大规模巡天具有重要意义。
summary: The distinction between brightest cluster galaxies (BCGs) and intracluster light (ICL) remains ambiguous, with inferred cluster properties depending strongly on the adopted definition and measurement methodology. We report the presence of a common inflection feature in the radial profiles of surface brightness, ellipticity, and position angle of BCG+ICL systems, indicative of a structural transition in the underlying stellar distribution. Using a combination of low redshift clusters (z < 0.1) observed with the Wendelstein Wide Field Imager, deep Hyper Suprime-Cam observations of clusters at 0.2 < z < 0.4, and cosmological hydrodynamical simulations from Horizon-AGN and Hydrangea, we consistently identify a common inflection at radii of 60-85 kpc. We interpret this feature as a characteristic transition in the combined BCG+ICL light distribution, that may reflect the hierarchical assembly of the cluster. The persistence of this feature across multiple photometric bands, redshift ranges, and simulations supports its robustness. To identify these transitions, we employ an automated second derivative based approach that does not rely on parametric decompositions or arbitrary surface brightness thresholds. This framework provides a physically motivated and scalable means to characterise the BCG-ICL transition, and it will be of paramount importance for forthcoming large scale surveys such as the Legacy Survey of Space and Time and the European Space Agency's Euclid mission.

title: A full chemical network treatment of supermassive black hole seed formation from dark matter annihilation or decay
background_knowledge: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的形成与演化是连接星系形成、宇宙黎明和吸积物理的核心问题。观测上，$z \sim 6$ 至 $10.1$ 的高红移类星体已包含质量可达 $10^8$ 至 $10^{10}\,M_\odot$ 的 SMBH，而宇宙年龄尚不足 $10^9$ 年；从第一代恒星残骸出发的轻种子即使经历超爱丁顿吸积，也面临严峻的时间尺度挑战。另一条路径是原初、无尘、无金属气体云在强紫外（UV）辐射场中抑制分子氢 $\mathrm{H}_2$ 冷却，避免碎裂并整体直接坍缩为黑洞种子，即直接坍缩黑洞（DCBH）模型。传统上，这一 UV 场常归因于邻近星族或吸积源；若暗物质粒子质量很低，例如 $\lesssim 200\,\mathrm{eV}$，其衰变或湮灭也可产生 UV 光子，并在宇宙学背景及早期暗物质晕内部影响气体热化学演化，其中湮灭率对密度平方的依赖使晕内辐射尤为重要。该方向需要把非平衡化学网络、冷却函数、辐射背景与一区或流体力学模拟结合起来，是宇宙学、粒子物理与黑洞种子形成交叉的研究范式。
contribution: 论文采用完整化学网络处理低质量暗物质通过衰变或湮灭促进 SMBH 种子形成的问题，系统检验其能否为原初气体直接坍缩提供足够 UV 辐射。作者使用 Grackle 化学与冷却库，对一区原初气体云进行热化学模拟，在暗物质寿命、湮灭截面和质量构成的多维参数空间中追踪气体热演化，并同时考虑宇宙学 UV 背景与早期暗物质晕内部的辐射贡献，检验质量低于 $\sim 200\,\mathrm{eV}$ 的暗物质能否产生足够通量来光致解离 $\mathrm{H}_2$、抑制碎裂。**该分析确定了可实现直接坍缩的参数空间区域，并给出对应的最大暗物质晕质量要求，从而把暗物质微观参数与 SMBH 种子形成条件定量联系起来。**
summary: The recent discoveries of high-redshift quasars at $z\sim6-10.1$ present a challenge to conventional supermassive black hole (SMBH) formation scenarios: their central SMBHs are too large to have grown from early stellar remnants, even under efficient super-Eddington accretion. An alternative approach is the direct collapse of primordial, dust- and metal-free gas clouds into black hole seeds as early as $z\sim20$. To prevent fragmentation from highly efficient molecular hydrogen cooling and allow such a collapse, a strong flux of UV photons is required to photodissociate molecular hydrogen, suppressing star formation. We investigate whether the decay or annihilation of dark matter with masses below $\sim200$ eV can produce sufficient UV radiation, both from the cosmological background and within early dark matter halos. Using thermal simulations of a one-zone primordial gas cloud model with the Grackle chemistry and cooling library, we map the resulting gas behavior across a range of dark matter lifetimes, cross sections, and masses. From this, we determine regions of parameter space where direct collapse into an SMBH is possible and the corresponding maximum halo mass required.

title: Ly$α$ in Compact Broad-Line Emitters, Including Little Red Dots, Is More Closely Linked to the Host Galaxy than to the Broad-Line Nucleus
background_knowledge: 在高红移宇宙中，活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积供能，其宽线区（BLR）产生宽达数千 km s$^{-1}$ 的巴尔末发射线；宿主星系则通过恒星形成产生窄发射线和电离光子。JWST 在 $z > 4$ 处发现大量暗弱宽线 AGN，其中包括紧凑宽线发射体（CBEs）与“小红点”（LRDs），它们究竟是再电离的重要光子源，还是被尘埃遮蔽的星系，仍存争议。Ly$\alpha$ 是氢的共振线，对中性氢与尘埃极为敏感，既可来自 AGN 的 BLR，也可由宿主星系年轻恒星电离后复合产生；其共振散射还会重塑线型与逃逸率。因此，判断高红移宽线源的 Ly$\alpha$ 来自黑洞还是宿主，是解释其能谱、黑洞成长与电离光子预算的关键。观测上常以宽 H$\alpha$ 证认 BLR，并用 AGN 扣除后的多波段 SED 拟合估计宿主性质、尘埃衰减与 Ly$\alpha$ 产生率。
contribution: 论文利用 DIVER 计划的深场 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱，在 GOODS-N 中测量了 12 个 $z = 4.2$--$5.5$ 的 CBEs（包括 LRDs、little blue dots 及其他宽线 AGN）的 Ly$\alpha$。12 个源均有宽线区，其中 6 个探测到 Ly$\alpha$。关键结果是：**Ly$\alpha$ 的强弱并不跟随宽线核**——相对 UV 的 H$\alpha$ 最强源中既有弱探测也有非探测，且所有探测到的 Ly$\alpha$ 线宽（FWHM 约 300--1000 km s$^{-1}$）都窄于宽 H$\alpha$（1100--3300 km s$^{-1}$）。相反，**观测到的 Ly$\alpha$ 更紧密地追踪宿主星系**。作者用尘埃衰减的 SED 拟合对 AGN 扣除后的宿主建模；计入上限后，无论是等值宽还是光度，观测 Ly$\alpha$ 都更符合该宿主模型预言的 Ly$\alpha$ 产生，而非 H$\alpha$/UV。每个探测源的 Ly$\alpha$ 比宿主模型值高 1.5--18 倍，仍为核区贡献留出空间。**黑洞在这些源中可见，但观测到的 Ly$\alpha$ 与宿主联系更密切**；探测源的中位有效 Ly$\alpha$ 逃逸分数仅 0.09，暗示 CBEs 的电离光子逃逸通常不高且差异很大。
summary: JWST has found many faint broad-line AGN at $z>4$, but it is unclear whether the Ly$α$ we see from them comes from the accreting black hole or from its host galaxy. The answer matters for how these sources are interpreted and for how many ionizing photons they release. We use deep JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy from the DIVER program to measure Ly$α$ in 12 compact broad-line emitters (CBEs) at $z=4.2$--5.5 in GOODS-N. CBEs include little red dots (LRDs), little blue dots, and other broad-line AGN. Six are detected in Ly$α$. Every source shows a broad-line region, yet Ly$α$ does not follow it: the sources with the strongest H$α$ relative to the UV include weak detections and nondetections, and every detected Ly$α$ line (FWHM $\approx300$--1000~km~s$^{-1}$) is narrower than broad H$α$ (1100--3300~km~s$^{-1}$). Instead, Ly$α$ appears to track the host galaxy. We model the AGN-subtracted host with a dust-attenuated SED fit. Including the upper limits, the observed Ly$α$ follows the Ly$α$ production in this host model more closely than it follows H$α$/UV, in both equivalent width and luminosity. Every detection exceeds its host-model value by a factor of 1.5--18, leaving room for a nuclear contribution. The black hole is visible in these sources, but the Ly$α$ we observe is more closely tied to its host. The median effective Ly$α$ escape fraction of the detections is only 0.09, which suggests that ionizing escape from CBEs is typically modest and varies widely.

title: Gaia's dark partners: A new signature of dissipative dark matter
background_knowledge: 暗物质与暗能量是现代宇宙学和粒子物理交叉的核心问题。宇宙学观测表明，暗物质约占总能量密度的四分之一以上，主导星系和宇宙大尺度结构的形成，但其粒子性质仍未知。主流冷暗物质模型通常假设暗物质无碰撞、仅通过引力作用，因此不会像重子物质那样通过辐射冷却形成暗盘或致密天体。耗散暗物质是一种扩展图像：暗物质中有一个子成分可通过暗辐射冷却，进而形成速度弥散 $\sigma_v$ 较小的暗盘和暗致密天体（DCO），其中可包括暗黑洞。若银河系中存在这类慢速不可见天体，它们会参与恒星双星的动力学演化。双星动力学交换是指第三个天体与双星相遇并替换其中一个成员；该过程对入射天体的速度分布很敏感，扰动体越慢，交换截面越大。Gaia 任务通过高精度天体测量和视向速度给出了大规模双星样本，并发现若干疑似恒星—黑洞双星，为测量慢速暗致密天体的丰度提供了新途径。该方向的研究范式是把双星散射或交换率计算、暗物质模型参数扫描与 Gaia 双星统计相比较，从恒星—暗致密天体双星的数目和性质反推暗扇区冷却参数。
contribution: 论文评估了由耗散暗物质（DDM）形成的暗致密天体（DCO，包括但不限于黑洞）通过动力学交换进入恒星—恒星双星、并形成恒星—DCO 双星的速率，并将该预测与 Gaia 已观测到的候选系统进行对照。其物理要点是：交换过程对慢速扰动体特别高效，而 DDM 的子成分冷却后可自然产生低速度弥散的 DCO 种群，因此恒星—DCO 双星可作为探测这类慢速暗天体的敏感探针。结果表明，在广泛的参数空间内，即使采用保守假设，交换率也足以产生 Gaia 至今观测到的对象；在部分参数空间中，预测的交换率明显高于由观测估计的速率。**因此，当前 Gaia 数据已可对 DDM 参数空间给出有竞争力的限制，并使 Gaia 成为检验暗扇区冷却的重要平台；未来数据有望进一步收紧约束。**
summary: The Gaia mission has greatly improved our understanding of the stellar binary population. Beyond providing an extensive catalog of binary systems with two luminous stars, Gaia has also discovered several systems that appear to be star--black hole (BH) binaries. One of the leading candidate formation channels for these systems is dynamical exchange, in which one component of a star--star binary is ejected from the system and replaced by a BH. Exchange processes are very sensitive to the velocity distribution of the incoming objects, and become very efficient in the limit that perturbers are slow, so the exchanged binary population is a sensitive probe of slow-moving objects. A population of slow-moving, nonluminous objects is naturally produced in dissipative dark matter (DDM) scenarios, where a subcomponent of dark matter can cool to form a dark disk and dark compact objects (DCOs), including but not limited to BHs, with a small velocity dispersion. In this work, we evaluate the rate at which DCOs formed by DDM exchange into star--star binaries to form star--DCO binaries. We find that in a wide range of parameter space, even under conservative assumptions, the rate of exchange interactions is sufficient to produce the objects that Gaia has observed to date. In some portions of parameter space, the predicted exchange rate is well in excess of the rate estimated from observations. We point out the potential for competitive constraints on the DDM parameter space with current and future data, making the Gaia mission an important testbed for dark sector cooling.

title: 3D dark matter map of the JWST COSMOS-Web field using diffusion-based generative priors
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型 $\Lambda$CDM 认为，暗物质约占宇宙物质预算的主要部分，并在引力作用下从早期微小的密度扰动逐渐增长，形成由纤维状结构、节点和空洞组成的宇宙网。由于暗物质不发光，直接观测其三维分布十分困难，弱引力透镜提供了一条关键途径：前景物质会轻微扭曲背景星系图像，使星系形状产生相关剪切。统计测量这种剪切可以反推沿视线的投影质量分布，常用收敛场 $\kappa$ 与剪切场 $\gamma$ 描述。传统二维弱透镜质量图只能给出视线积分后的投影结构，不同距离上的物质会叠加在一起；三维弱透镜层析则利用不同红移的背景星系和物理前向模型，尝试恢复沿视线分层的物质分布。该方向的核心挑战是反演问题病态、噪声大且需先验约束。近年来，基于宇宙学模拟训练的生成模型，尤其是扩散模型，可作为贝叶斯先验提供符合宇宙网统计性质的非高斯场，并通过后验采样量化不确定性。JWST 的高红移、高数密度星系成像为把三维弱透镜制图推向更远宇宙提供了新数据基础。
contribution: 论文利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）在 0.54 deg$^2$ 的 COSMOS-Web 天区的深成像，以 121 个星系 arcmin$^{-2}$ 的有效源密度，将物理弱透镜前向模型与从宇宙学模拟学习到的基于扩散模型的贝叶斯生成先验结合，重建三维物质分布。**在 20 个透镜平面上给出了直到 $z \simeq 2$ 的暗物质场后验分布，将此前基于哈勃空间望远镜的三维弱透镜重建的红移范围扩展了一倍，并接近宇宙正午。** 重建能够分离投影上重叠的结构，在多个空间尺度上恢复非高斯物质结构，包括与独立识别的星系团相关的过密区，而这些星系团在此前弱透镜图中未被探测到。后验采样量化了数据允许的三维物质分布范围，实现了宇宙网的概率可视化并传播其结构推断的不确定性。零检验与基于模拟的检验表明，恢复的结构由透镜信号支持，并与基准 $\Lambda$CDM 宇宙学预期一致。**这些结果把三维弱透镜制图推进到高红移、非高斯区域，并为利用当前宽视场透镜巡天对演化宇宙网进行概率制图建立了途径。**
summary: Mapping the three-dimensional distribution of dark matter is key to tracing the growth of cosmic structure. Two-dimensional weak lensing mass maps recover its projected distribution, but they blend structures at different distances along the line of sight. We reconstruct the three-dimensional matter distribution in the 0.54 deg$^2$ COSMOS-Web field using deep James Webb Space Telescope imaging, with an effective source density of 121 galaxies arcmin$^{-2}$ We combine a physical weak lensing forward model with a diffusion-based Bayesian generative prior learned from cosmological simulations, yielding a posterior distribution of the matter field across 20 lens planes to $z \simeq 2$, doubling the redshift reach of previous Hubble Space Telescope-based 3D reconstructions and approaching cosmic noon, an epoch of rapid galaxy growth. The reconstruction separates structures that overlap in projection and recovers non-Gaussian matter structure across a range of spatial scales, including over-densities associated with independently identified galaxy clusters that were not detected in earlier weak lensing maps. Posterior sampling quantifies the range of three-dimensional matter distributions allowed by the data, enabling a probabilistic visualization of the cosmic web while propagating uncertainties in its inferred structure. Null and simulation-based tests show that the recovered structures are supported by the lensing signal and are consistent with expectations from the fiducial $Λ$CDM cosmology. These results extend three-dimensional weak lensing mapping into the high-redshift, non-Gaussian regime and establish a route towards probabilistic mapping of the evolving cosmic web with current wide-field lensing surveys.

title: Precision Requirements for Robust Small Planet Classification
background_knowledge: 系外行星的总体成分分类通常依赖质量 $M$ 与半径 $R$ 得到的平均密度，并与理论质量—半径关系比较：较低密度可能指示富挥发分大气或冰层，较高密度可能指示富铁成分。但 $M$-$R$ 关系存在成分退化，且观测误差会传播到密度与分类置信度。Nominally Rocky Planet Zone（NRPZ）利用宿主恒星丰度分布校准无挥发分岩石行星的预期密度范围，从而为区分 rocky、volatile-rich 与 iron-enriched 行星提供判据；其有效性高度依赖质量、半径及恒星参数的测量精度。对小行星而言，大气表征资源稀缺，因此需要先进行可靠分类并优先排序。
contribution: 本文针对 37 颗候选小行星（半径低于 2 倍地球半径、宿主星视星等 $V<11$），在 NRPZ 分类框架中解析传播观测误差。**其中 12 颗已有足够精确的质量与半径，可自信归类为 Mini-Neptunes 或 Super-Mercuries**；其余行星需将质量与半径的联合不确定度降低约 60% 才能可靠分类。为达到该精度需新增约 1–1,000 次观测，且这很可能是下限。作者认为如此密集的观测对多数行星未必可行，**仅靠质量—半径模型难以分类除密度离群者之外的大多数行星**，因此建议采用分阶段策略：先用改进的质量与半径测量识别并优先安排仍有歧义的系统，再在可行时利用 JWST 或未来设施的大气观测，作为检验这些行星是否保留显著大气的补充手段。
summary: Classifying small exoplanets as rocky, volatile-rich, or iron-enriched is a prerequisite for efficient allocation of atmospheric characterization resources. The Nominally Rocky Planet Zone (NRPZ) provides a framework for this classification by comparing observed bulk densities against the expected density range for volatile-free rocky planets, calibrated from stellar abundance distributions. However, the efficacy of classifying a planet using the NRPZ is critically dependent on the precision of the underlying mass and radius measurements. Here, we perform an analytical propagation of observational uncertainties through the NRPZ classification framework for 37 candidate rocky exoplanets with radii below 2 Earth radii orbiting stars with visual magnitudes <11. Among the 37 planets, we find 12 already possess sufficiently precise mass and radius measurements to be confidently classified as Mini-Neptunes or Super-Mercuries. The remaining planets require approximately a ~60% reduction in the combined mass and radius uncertainties before they can be reliably classified. We find that 1-1,000 new observations are necessary to achieve these lower uncertainties, and these are likely lower limits. We argue that, while possible, this level of intense observation is likely not feasible for many of these planets and that mass-radius models alone are not likely to allow us to classify all but those planets with outlier densities. We therefore recommend a staged strategy in which improved mass and radius measurements are used to identify and prioritize ambiguous systems, followed (where feasible) by atmospheric observations with JWST or future facilities as a complementary test of whether selected planets retain substantial atmospheres.

title: The STARfall pathway: forging intermediate-mass black holes through stellar collisions in dense star clusters
background_knowledge: 恒星级黑洞由大质量恒星核心坍缩形成，质量通常为数十倍太阳质量；超大质量黑洞则位于星系中心，质量可达百万至十亿倍太阳质量。二者之间约 $10^2$–$10^5\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ 的中等质量黑洞（IMBH）观测稀少，其形成路径仍不明确。一个重要的理论场景是：在致密星团中，核心坍缩和动力学相互作用把恒星密集地聚集起来，双星与单星相遇可触发反复的并合与碰撞，使一颗恒星长成甚大质量恒星（VMS），最终坍缩为 IMBH 种子。该过程取决于星团中心密度、核心坍缩时标、双星性质、恒星风质量损失以及星团演化；球状星团、高红移致密星团和 Little Red Dots 等系统可作为检验对象。相关研究通常把星团动力学演化与恒星演化耦合起来，用 N 体、蒙特卡洛或半解析方法追踪质量增长与坍缩。
contribution: 作者提出并开发了 STARfall 半解析工具，追踪致密星团中一个大质量双星系统在 binary–single 相互作用、并合、碰撞和恒星演化下的演化，并自洽计入宿主星团的演化。以星团初始条件为变量，系统研究 VMS 与 IMBH 种子的形成。结果显示：中心密度高于 $10^6\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}\,\mathrm{pc}^{-3}$ 的星团可在 $3\,\mathrm{Myr}$ 内经历一连串灾难性恒星碰撞，即 **“starastrophe”**；在此过程中，VMS 迅速增长质量，并在强烈恒星风的影响下仍可坍缩成质量可达 $10^3$–$10^4\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ 的 IMBH。将模型应用于观测系统后，作者发现 Cosmic Gems Arc 中的致密星团和银河系球状星团可能曾孕育此类 VMS，并坍缩为上述质量范围的 IMBH；Little Red Dots 的推断中心密度虽对应更长的核心坍缩时标，也可能支持同一质量区间的 IMBH 形成。文章进一步指出，VMS 的组装需要两个关键条件：**短核心坍缩时标**与**高中心密度**。总体而言，模型表明 Cosmic Gems Arc 的星团和若干银河系球状星团可能曾形成直接坍缩为 $10^3$–$10^4\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ IMBH 的 VMS。
summary: Intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs, $10^2 < m_{\rm BH}/\mathrm{M}_{\odot} < 10^5$) are elusive objects bridging the gap between stellar-mass and supermassive black holes, whose origin remains uncertain. They may form from the collapse of very massive stars (VMSs, $m_*\geq150\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$) assembled through repeated stellar collisions in compact and fast evolving star clusters. We investigate the formation of VMSs and IMBH seeds via repeated mergers and collisions as a function of cluster initial conditions, assessing the implications for globular clusters and dense high-redshift system. We develop STARfall, a semi-analytic tool that follows the evolution of a massive stellar binary via binary-single interactions, mergers, collisions, and stellar evolution, while consistently accounting for the host cluster evolution. Our results show that clusters with central densities above $10^6\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}\,\mathrm{pc}^{-3}$ can undergo a catastrophic sequence of stellar collisions, or "starastrophe", within $3$ Myr. Through this process, VMSs rapidly grow in mass and collapse into IMBHs with masses of up to $10^3-10^4\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$, despite the effects of intense stellar winds. Applying our models to observed systems, we find that compact clusters in the Cosmic Gems Arc and Milky Way globular clusters could have hosted VMSs that collapsed into IMBHs in this mass range. Despite their longer core-collapse timescales, the inferred central densities of Little Red Dots may also support IMBH formation in the same mass interval. Our models show that VMS assembly requires two essential ingredients: short core-collapse times and large central densities. Compared to observed systems, our models suggest that clusters in the Cosmic Gems Arcs and several Galactic globular clusters could have nurtured VMSs that directly collapsed to IMBHs with masses $10^3-10^4\,\text{M}_{\odot}$.

title: Probing the Faint Outskirts of Star-Forming Galaxies with 1<z<9 Using Stacked Images
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注星系如何从高红移暗物质晕中吸积气体、形成恒星，并通过并合、反馈和盘的不稳定过程塑造可见结构。主流图像认为盘星系往往由内向外（inside-out）生长：内区先形成并富集金属，外缘较晚组装，因此外缘的颜色、年龄和金属丰度梯度记录了星系组装史。星系最外围的低表面亮度光还可能包含恒星晕、吸积来的卫星星系残骸和被盘加热的恒星，是检验 ex-situ 与 in-situ 增长的重要探针。观测上，高红移星系外缘极其暗弱，且表面亮度随红移按 $(1+z)^4$ 变暗，角尺寸和望远镜点扩散函数（PSF）也会混淆信号；因此常用深度成像、按质量与红移分箱 stacking、以及空白天区背景扣除来测量平均外缘轮廓。颜色梯度、轮廓的指数标度长度及其与质量—大小关系的关系，是判断外缘是否只是内区生长的延续，还是独立记录吸积成分的关键。
contribution: 论文利用 CEERS、JADES 和 PRIMER 巡天的深 JWST/NIRCam 成像，从 DAWN JWST Archive 选取 14,812 个红移 $1<z<9$、恒星质量 $\log(M_*/M_{\odot})>8.5$ 的 face-on 盘星系，按恒星质量和红移分箱 stacking，并校正宇宙学表面亮度变暗、角尺寸缩放与 PSF 卷积，还用空白天区 stack 估计残余背景。结果显示，星系颜色轮廓总体随半径变蓝，呈负颜色梯度，**支持盘星系由内向外生长**；但在 $z>2.5$、$\log(M_*/M_{\odot})<9.5$ 的星系中，最外围出现微弱反转，**暗示早期恒星种群梯度更复杂**。外缘光轮廓总体呈良好的指数衰减，$2R_e$ 以外的外标度长度随质量和红移的变化与常规质量—大小关系高度相似，**表明延展外缘光与内区增长受同一类过程支配，而非早期宇宙 ex-situ 恒星成分的直接示踪**。外标度长度还几乎不依赖波长，**说明尘埃衰减在这些半径处影响有限**。这些结果为宇宙正午及更早时期延展恒星分布的构建提供了新约束。
summary: We present a systematic study of the faint outer light profiles of star-forming galaxies using deep JWST/NIRCam imaging from the CEERS, JADES, and PRIMER surveys. Our sample consists of 14,812 face-on disk galaxies at $1<z<9$ with $\log(M_*/M_{\odot})>8.5$, selected from the DAWN JWST Archive. To characterize the low-surface-brightness outskirts beyond the effective radius ($R_e$), we stack galaxies in bins of stellar mass and redshift, accounting for cosmological surface-brightness dimming, angular-size scaling, and PSF convolution, and estimate residual backgrounds from blank-sky stacks. The color profiles generally become bluer toward larger radii, indicating negative color gradients and supporting an inside-out growth scenario. Galaxies with $\log(M_*/M_{\odot}) < 9.5$ at $z>2.5$ exhibit a weak reversal in their outermost regions, suggesting more complex stellar population gradients at early times. The outer light profiles generally exhibit a good exponential decline with radius, and the outer scale lengths measured beyond $2R_e$ show mass and redshift dependences remarkably similar to those of the conventional mass-size relation. This similarity suggests that the extended outer light is closely linked to the same processes governing the growth of the inner galaxy, rather than providing a direct tracer of ex-situ stellar components in the early universe. We also find little wavelength dependence in the outer scale lengths, indicating that dust attenuation likely has a limited impact at these radii. These results provide new constraints on the buildup of extended stellar distributions during cosmic noon and at earlier epochs.

title: The TNG50-SKIRT Atlas: Multi-wavelength properties of galaxy discs in the TNG50 simulation
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕中重子物质如何冷却、坍缩并形成盘、核球与恒星，以及这些结构随宇宙时间的演化。盘星系中恒星多沿近圆轨道运动，其径向表面亮度分布常近似为指数律 $I(R)=I_0 e^{-R/h}$，其中 $h$ 为盘标长；标长刻画盘的空间延展，并与星系恒星质量、光度、角动量和恒星形成历史相联系。观测上通常从多波段图像提取一维径向表面亮度剖面并拟合标长，但不同波段探测的恒星族不同，且尘埃衰减会改变短波辐射，故标长的波长依赖携带恒星年龄、金属丰度与尘埃分布的信息。数值模拟方面，宇宙学流体模拟 TNG50 提供星系形成与演化的物理演化，而 SKIRT 等辐射转移后处理可生成包含尘埃与恒星族信息的合成观测，使模拟星系能与真实星系的结构标度关系进行类观测比较。
contribution: 本文基于 TNG50-SKIRT Atlas（TSA）的多波段合成图像，测量星系盘的一维径向表面亮度剖面及盘标长，并检验模拟星系能否再现真实星系的结构性质与标度关系。作者对每个星系交互式定义盘主导区域，并在各波段一致地应用；样本限制为近正面、恒星形成星系，且仅保留 $r$ 波段剖面可用指数模型良好描述的系统。研究将测得的标长与观测样本比较，并同时分析含尘埃衰减、无尘埃图像以及内禀恒星族分布图。结果表明，大多数 TSA 星系在逼真模拟观测中呈现指数盘；TSA 星系能再现观测到的盘标长—恒星质量（光度）关系，但在固定质量或光度下**盘标长系统性偏大**。标长对形态的依赖较弱；不同波段标长强相关，但随波长增加而系统性减小。按恒星质量标长归一化后，TSA 星系在光学至近红外区间呈现与观测一致的单调趋势。通过比较无尘埃与含尘埃衰减图像并联系内禀星系性质，作者发现**恒星族梯度是标长波长依赖的主要驱动**，其中**径向恒星年龄梯度占主导，金属丰度梯度起次要作用**；尘埃衰减在短波进一步放大波长依赖，但**并非其主要起源**。绝对标长的残余偏移则反映了模拟与观测星系结构之间仍存在的差异。
summary: We investigate the wavelength dependence of disc scale lengths in galaxies from the TNG50-SKIRT Atlas (TSA), and assess whether the simulated galaxies reproduce the structural properties and scaling relations observed in real galaxies. We measure disc scale lengths from 1D radial surface-brightness profiles of multi-wavelength synthetic images. The disc-dominated region is defined interactively per galaxy and applied consistently across bands. We restrict the analysis to nearly face-on, star-forming galaxies and retain only systems whose r-band profiles are well described by an exponential model. The resulting scale lengths are compared to observational samples and analysed using both dust-attenuated and dust-free images, as well as intrinsic stellar population maps. We find that the majority of TSA galaxies exhibit exponential discs in realistic mock observations. TSA galaxies reproduce the observed disc scale length-stellar mass (luminosity) relation, but are systematically larger at fixed mass or luminosity. The dependence of disc scale length on morphology is weak. Disc scale lengths correlate strongly across wavelengths, but decrease systematically with increasing wavelength. When normalised by the stellar-mass scale length, TSA galaxies exhibit a monotonic trend consistent with observations over the optical-to-NIR range. Comparing dust-free and dust-attenuated images and linking the results to intrinsic galaxy properties, we find that stellar population gradients are the primary driver of this wavelength dependence. In particular, radial gradients in stellar age dominate the effect, while metallicity gradients play a secondary role. Dust attenuation further enhances the wavelength dependence at short wavelengths but is not its main origin. Residual offsets in absolute scale length indicate the remaining differences between simulated and observed galaxy structure.

title: A Unified AI Framework for Rapid and Accurate Waveform Generation of Compact Binary Coalescences
background_knowledge: 引力波天文学通过测量时空的微小应变来研究致密天体的并合过程。紧凑双星并合（compact binary coalescence）包括双黑洞（BBH）、双中子星（BNS）以及中子星—黑洞（NSBH）等系统；其引力波信号通常经历旋近、并合和铃宕阶段，并携带关于质量、自旋、轨道偏心率、物态方程及并合后物质行为的丰富信息。数据分析主要依赖匹配滤波：将探测器数据与大量理论波形模板进行相关分析，从而提取信号并估计参数。因此，波形模型既要在相对论动力学、物质效应和辐射过程上足够精确，又要在面对长持续时间信号和大规模模板库时足够快速。第三代地面引力波探测器（如 Einstein Telescope 和 Cosmic Explorer）预计能观测到大量持续时间长、周期数多的并合信号，这对波形生成的精度、覆盖范围和计算效率提出了更高要求。传统物理波形模型通常通过解析近似、数值相对论校准或有效单体质等方法构建，精度高但计算成本可观；深度学习则可能提供快速代理模型，但其物理完备性与跨系统泛化能力需要专门设计。
contribution: 论文提出一个将物理建模与深度学习结合的统一框架：采用解析残差谱表示、共享学习以及面向各双星类型的解码器，**构建了覆盖 BBH、BNS 与 NSBH 的单一统一波形生成器**。生成波形包含各参考模型所描述的物理效应，如自旋进动、高阶模式、物质效应以及 BNS 的并合后辐射；波形可覆盖数百至数千个周期。相对于参考波形，**平均失配度（mismatch）为 $5.89\times 10^{-4}$ 至 $5.34\times 10^{-2}$**；在批量生成时，**相对于参考波形生成的最高加速约 1800 倍**。
summary: The astrophysical discovery potential of future gravitational wave detectors will hinge on accurate and rapid waveform generation. Third generation detectors are expected to observe many long duration compact binary coalescence signals that can probe binary formation and evolution as well as the nature of matter under extreme conditions. We develop a unified framework that combines physical modeling with deep learning. The framework uses an analytic residual spectral representation, shared learning, and decoders for each binary type. It generates waveforms for binary black holes, binary neutron stars, and neutron star black hole binaries, providing a single unified generator for all compact binary coalescences. The generated waveforms include the physical effects described by each reference model, such as spin precession, higher order modes, matter effects, and postmerger radiation for binary neutron stars. The waveforms span hundreds to thousands of cycles, with mean mismatches ranging from $5.89\times10^{-4}$ to $5.34\times10^{-2}$ relative to the reference waveforms. Batch generation achieves a maximum speedup of about 1800 over reference waveform generation.

title: Fitting Resonant Exoplanets Orbits. I. Properties and Applications of Fixed-Point Orbits
background_knowledge: 系外行星系统的动力学与轨道拟合研究行星之间的引力相互作用、轨道稳定性以及系统形成演化历史。当两颗或多颗行星的轨道周期接近简单整数比时，可形成平均运动共振（mean-motion resonance，MMR）；在共振构型中，特定的共振角往往围绕平衡值振荡，即天平动。紧密的共振链能够提高系统的动力学稳定性，并可能记录行星迁移和早期演化信息。多数成熟的多行星系统并不处于共振，但在年轻系统中共振比例可能更高。观测上，系外行星轨道可由径向速度（radial velocity，RV）、天体测量、直接成像和凌星等方法约束；轨道拟合通常参数多、简并强，标准方法主要最小化观测残差，而把动力学稳定性留到拟合之后检验。固定点轨道（fixed-point orbit，fPO）是共振动力学中的共面、严格周期构型，常可作为耗散演化下的吸引子；将拟合限制在 fPO 上可显著减少自由参数，并使解在构造上满足稳定性要求。
contribution: 论文提出一种在轨道拟合过程中优先获得稳定解的方法：将允许的解限制为与共振动力学相关的稳定固定点轨道（fPOs），即共面且严格周期的构型。作者指出，耗散演化会把共振系统驱动向 fPO 状态，因此对于自形成以来未经历大规模动力学重排的行星系统，采用 fPO 约束拟合具有物理动机。该模型大幅减少自由参数，并且**由构造保证解的稳定性**。作者通过 $\chi^2$ 最小化确定最佳拟合 fPO，并将方法应用于直接成像的 PDS 70 与 HR 8799 的天体测量数据，以及 GJ 876 的径向速度数据。对 HR 8799，作者**独立复现了此前报道的共振解**，说明方法具有可靠性。对 PDS 70，拟合解分为两组，其中外侧行星 c 的质量 $m_c$ 大于内侧行星 b 的质量 $m_b$ 的一组与以往测量更一致。对 GJ 876，fPO 拟合与此前无约束拟合相当，**加强了其行星深处于共振的判断**。
summary: Intact chains of mean-motion resonances may preserve information about the formation and early dynamical evolution of multiplanet systems. Although most mature multiplanet systems are non-resonant, the resonant fraction may have been substantially higher at young ages. Establishing whether exoplanet data are consistent with a resonant configuration is often challenging because the planetary orbits must be sufficiently well constrained. Moreover, while resonance configurations promote stability, standard orbital fitting methods do not impose such a dynamical constraint, with stability tested only a posteriori. As the first step in a series of papers aimed at favoring stable orbital solutions during the fitting process, we develop a method that restricts solutions to stable fixed-point orbits (fPOs)---coplanar, exactly periodic configurations associated with resonant dynamics. We show that dissipative evolution drive resonant systems toward an fPO state, motivating for fPO-constrained fitting for those planet systems that have avoided large-scale dynamical rearrangements since formation. The fPO model greatly reduces the number of free parameters and yields stable solutions by construction. We determine the best-fitting fPos through $χ^2$ minimization and apply the method to astrometric data for the directly imaged PDS 70 and HR 8799 systems and to radial-velocity data for GJ 876. For HR 8799 we independently recover a previously reported resonant solution, illustrating the fidelity of our method. For PDS 70 we find solutions fall in two groups, with the group where the outer planet c mass exceeds planet b more aligned with previous measurements. Finally, For GJ 876 our fPO fit is on par with previous unconstrained fitting, which strengthens the case that its planets reside deep in resonance.

title: Mapping large-scale structure without galaxy formation - combining fast radio bursts with CMB lensing
background_knowledge: 大尺度结构研究关注宇宙中物质密度扰动的统计性质及其随时间的演化。其基本图像是：早期宇宙的微小密度涨落，在引力不稳定性作用下逐步增长，形成今日的星系、星系团以及更大尺度的纤维状结构。观测上，人们通过星系巡天、弱引力透镜、宇宙微波背景（CMB）温度与偏振、以及 CMB 透镜等方式测量物质分布及其关联。CMB 弱透镜直接反映沿视线方向积分的总物质引力势，因此对宇宙学参数如 $ \sigma_8 $（物质涨落幅度）和 $ \Omega_m $（物质密度参数）敏感。快速射电暴（FRB）的色散量则沿视线积分自由电子密度，可用来探测星系际介质和宇宙大尺度电子分布。关键物理前提是：自由电子分布与总物质分布高度相关，因此 FRB 色散关联可作为一种新的物质结构探针。与传统星系巡天相比，这类探针的独特之处在于，大尺度上它可能较少受星系形成细节、重子反馈模型以及偏置参数不确定性的影响。
contribution: 论文指出，自由电子分布几乎精确地跟随总物质分布，并利用 FLAMINGO 模拟首次估计了电子场级 bias 参数。作者表明，在已知少量电子自由参数后，电子分布在大尺度上可近似视为物质分布的第二次实现。基于这一事实，论文将 FRB 色散关联与 CMB 弱透镜结合，假设可获得具有红移的局域化 FRB，对未来宇宙学参数约束进行 forecast。由于这两类大尺度物质探针不强烈依赖重子反馈模型，也不依赖编码星系形成的参数，作者发现 **$ \sigma_8 $ 和 $ \Omega_m $ 的约束可达到与保守假设下 FRB 色散联合星系形状弱透镜相当或更好的水平**。这些结果支持将 FRB 数据作为宇宙结构的互补探针；随着局域化 FRB 宿主星系红移的获得，其宇宙学价值将尤为突出。
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are an emerging precision probe of cosmological fluctuations. The amount and quality of observed FRB data will grow enormously over the next decade. FRB dispersion data directly probe the free electron distribution up to intergalactic scales. Precision models of the free electron distribution are necessary to exploit this exciting new probe of large-scale structure. We show that the free electron distribution almost exactly follows the total matter distribution. We confirm this fact by estimating the electron field-level bias parameters for the first time from the FLAMINGO simulations. With simulation-based knowledge of a handful of electron free parameters, the electron distribution largely acts as a second realization of the matter distribution. Working on large scales, we can leverage this fact to combine FRB correlations with those of Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) weak lensing to constrain cosmological parameters. Assuming access to localized FRBs with redshifts, we perform cosmological forecasts using these two large-scale matter probes, which have no strong dependence on baryonic feedback models nor on parameters that encode galaxy formation. We show that the parameters $σ_8$ and $Ω_m$ are constrained at a level similar to or better than that obtained by combining FRB dispersion with weak lensing of galaxy shapes under conservative assumptions. These results motivate the use of FRB data as a complementary probe of cosmic structure and will be especially compelling as redshifts become available for localized FRB host galaxies.

title: Limits to research in astrophysics
background_knowledge: 天体物理研究通常通过电磁波、粒子与引力波等观测手段，结合理论建模和数值模拟，研究宇宙中天体的形成、演化与物理过程；其研究范式既包括小规模、问题驱动的观测与理论研究，也包括依赖大型望远镜、空间平台、超级计算与海量数据的“大科学”协作。该领域的前沿探索受两类边界约束：一类是基本物理限制，例如光速 $c$ 有限使遥远天体观测本质上是回溯过去，绝对零度 $0\ \mathrm{K}$ 不可达到，海森堡不确定性原理 $\Delta x\,\Delta p \ge \hbar/2$ 设定测量极限；另一类是资源与环境限制，例如能源、淡水、稀土元素等的储量与开采能力，常被纳入行星边界的框架。近年来科研产出与项目规模快速增长，伴随竞争加剧、工作强度上升和资源消耗增加，因此科研实践本身的可持续性、科研人员福祉与职业阶段公平逐渐成为元科学和科研政策讨论的重要议题。
contribution: 本文是一篇会议论文集文章，属于对天体物理科研实践的限制因素与可持续性的反思性讨论，而非报告新的观测结果或具体天体物理模型。文章从基本物理限制与物质资源限制出发，指出能源、淡水、稀土元素等的数量与开采能力均有限；在当前科研高速增长、追逐大规模且日益雄心勃勃项目的“采掘式”模式下，追问个体与集体在从事天体物理研究时究竟受到哪些限制。作者讨论日常工作中遇到的多类限制因素，并强调需要集体反思，**以迈向更可持续、更有效、并保障不同职业阶段研究者福祉的科研实践**。
summary: Fundamental physics faces several intrinsic limitations, such as the finite speed of light in vacuum, the absolute zero temperature, Heisenberg's uncertainty principle and so on. At the same time, the material resources necessary to conduct research in astrophysics, such as energy, fresh water, and rareearth elements, are also limited in both quantity and extraction capabilities, a concept often referred to as planetary boundaries. In the context of scientific research growing at a frenetic pace, following the greedy quenchless extractivist model of our era, and which is giving rise to an ever-increasing number of largescale, increasingly ambitious projects: what limits us, individually and collectively, in the practice of our occupation\,? In this conference proceeding, we discuss certain limiting factors we encounter in our daily work, which we need to reflect on collectively in order to move forward, toward a more sustainable and effective research that preserves the well-being of researchers, regardless of their career stage.

title: Feature-Based and Deep Learning Methods for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
background_knowledge: 时域天文学通过重复观测记录天体亮度随时间的变化，得到光变曲线。变星分类是理解恒星物理、银河系结构以及瞬变现象的基础任务之一。传统研究范式通常先从光变曲线中提取具有物理意义的特征，例如周期、振幅、颜色、结构函数和变率统计量，再使用随机森林、梯度提升或支持向量机等模型进行分类；这类方法样本效率较高、可解释性较强，但依赖特征工程和较完整的采样。深度学习则试图从原始或多波段光变曲线中端到端学习表示，然而天文时间序列常具有不等间隔采样、缺失观测、多波段异质、观测噪声和类别不平衡等特点，且高质量标签稀缺，给模型泛化带来显著挑战。ZTF 等大规模时域巡天提供了海量变星光变曲线，为系统比较特征方法与深度学习方法提供了数据基础。
contribution: 论文基于 ZTF StarEmbed 数据集（约 40,000 个天体、七个不平衡类别），系统比较基于特征的传统机器学习与直接输入原始光变曲线的端到端深度学习在变星分类中的表现。结果显示，使用物理驱动特征训练的经典模型**稳定优于直接处理原始光变曲线的深度网络**。作者指出，**有限标注数据是造成性能差距的重要因素**，而光变曲线的多变量、不规则采样和形态多样性进一步增加了深度学习建模的难度。尽管深度学习具备从观测中直接学习表示的潜力，**当前模型在现有训练集规模下仍泛化不足**。该工作为后续研究建立了定量基线，并强调需要通过扩大标注数据集以及在大规模无标签巡天数据上开展自监督预训练等途径，进一步释放深度学习在天文时间序列分析中的潜力。
summary: We compare feature-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning for variable star classification using the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) StarEmbed dataset, which contains about 40,000 objects across seven imbalanced classes. Classical models trained on physically motivated features consistently outperform deep networks trained directly on raw light curves. We find that limited labeled data contributes to the performance gap, while the multivariate, irregularly sampled, and morphologically diverse nature of light curves poses additional challenges for deep learning models. While deep learning holds promise for learning representations directly from observations, our results indicate that current models fail to generalize with the available training set size. These findings motivate further investigation of the benefits of scaling labeled datasets and self-supervised pretraining on large unlabeled surveys. This work establishes a quantitative baseline for future research and highlights the need for further innovations to unlock the potential of deep learning in astronomical time series analysis.

title: Structural axes of sources in the SUMSS survey and their alignments
background_knowledge: 射电星系与射电类星体是活动星系核（AGN）的重要表现：中心超大质量黑洞通过相对论性喷流向外注入能量，喷流与周围介质作用形成射电瓣并发出同步辐射。在千秒差距（kpc）尺度上，射电源常呈近似双瓣结构，其结构主轴（或位置角）记录了喷流在天空平面上的投影方向。若大量彼此独立的射电源主轴在较大天区上呈现相干朝向，就可能暗示超越单个 AGN 的物理机制，例如宇宙大尺度结构中的原初磁场、星系形成时的潮汐力矩、宇宙纤维结构对喷流方向的调制，或尚未完全控制的观测选择效应。过去已有工作报告从几度到更大角尺度上的射电源位置角对齐，但其统计显著性和系统误差仍存在争议；基于甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）的搜索也使南天样本相对稀疏。SUMSS（Sydney University Molonglo Sky Survey）是在 843 MHz 频段覆盖南天的射电巡天，为在欠采样南天检验 kpc 尺度结构轴对齐提供了互补样本。此类研究的关键统计难点包括：位置角分布随赤纬变化、扫描与拼接造成的图像畸变、以及在大天区反复搜索候选对齐区域带来的 look-elsewhere effect（多重比较效应）。因此需要构建均匀目录、校正系统误差，并用保留观测特征的模拟天图校准全局显著性。
contribution: 本文从 629 个 SUMSS 拼接图像中构建了 4087 个射电源的结构位置角目录：先用卷积神经网络给出初始角度估计，再校正图像坐标到天球坐标的畸变并进行目视检查。随后在 HEALPix 网格上使用坐标不变的平行输运统计量搜索局部对齐，并用遗传算法细化候选区域；同时用保留随赤纬变化的位置角分布、并经过相同搜索流程的模拟天图校准整个搜索的显著性。结果显示，若干区域看似存在较强的局部对齐，但在计入 look-elsewhere effect 后 **没有一个区域保持统计显著**，候选信号与全搜索中的随机涨落一致。因此，本文 **未发现 SUMSS 射电源结构轴存在统计显著对齐的证据**；所得到的南天位置角目录可为未来射电源形态与族群性质研究提供资源。
summary: Coherent orientations of extragalactic radio sources have been reported on large angular scales, but their statistical significance and susceptibility to observational systematics remain debated. Searches based on very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) also leave the far southern sky comparatively sparsely sampled. We test for local alignments of kiloparsec-scale radio source structural axes in the Sydney University Molonglo Sky Survey (SUMSS), providing a complementary probe in the undersampled southern sky. We constructed a catalog of structural position angles for 4087 sources from 629 SUMSS mosaics. A convolutional neural network supplied initial angle estimates, which were corrected for image-to-sky coordinate distortion and visually vetted. We searched for local alignments using a coordinate-invariant parallel transport statistic on HEALPix tessellations, then refined candidate regions with a genetic algorithm. We calibrated the significance of the full search against mock skies that preserve the declination-dependent position angle distribution and undergo the same search procedure. Several regions show apparently strong local alignment, but none remains statistically significant after accounting for the look-elsewhere effect. The candidate signals are consistent with chance fluctuations in the full search. We find no statistically significant evidence for alignment of structural axes of radio sources in SUMSS images. The resulting southern sky position angle catalog provides a useful resource for future studies of radio source morphology and population properties.

title: Spin Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Efficient Equivariant Learning for Vector and Spin Fields on the Sphere
background_knowledge: 在天体物理与宇宙学中，许多可观测量定义在球面上并具有自旋性质：当局部坐标架旋转角度 $\psi$ 时，自旋为 $s$ 的场按 $e^{-is\psi}$ 改变相位。典型例子包括宇宙微波背景（CMB）的偏振、弱引力透镜剪切以及行星大气风场。球面函数通常用球谐展开描述，而自旋场需用自旋加权球谐函数；旋转等变性意味着网络对球面坐标架的局部旋转具有可预测的变换行为。近年来，球面 Fourier 神经算子（SFNO）通过在球谐空间进行卷积来高效学习球面场映射，但原始方法主要面向标量场；如何将其严格推广到任意自旋场，并保持计算可行与旋转等变，是该方向的关键方法学问题。
contribution: 论文将球面 Fourier 神经算子（SFNO）推广到任意自旋场，提出基于提升球面卷积的 S$^2$FNO。方法以旋转群上的 Mackey 函数作为概念框架，并利用其调和表示以及球面与旋转群上的采样定理，实现精确且高效的计算。作者用这些构建模块组成自旋 SFNO，并实验验证其旋转等变性可达到机器精度；在已有基准上取得最先进性能，同时提出新的自旋场基准，表明**自旋感知模型优于标量模型**。核心贡献是提供了一套可精确旋转等变、适用于球面矢量与自旋场的高效学习框架。
summary: Many fields of physical interest on the sphere, such as wind, the polarisation of the cosmic microwave background and the shear of weak gravitational lensing, are spin fields, whose values change phase when the local frame rotates. We extend spherical Fourier neural operators (SFNOs) to fields of any spin, through lifted spherical convolutions that are exactly rotationally equivariant. Lifting spin fields to Mackey functions on the rotation group provides the conceptual framework, while computation is performed exactly and efficiently through their harmonic representation and by appealing to sampling theorems on the sphere and rotation group. We construct spin SFNOs (S$^2$FNOs) from these building blocks. We demonstrate empirically that rotational equivariance holds to machine precision for these layers. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks, and introduce new benchmarks on which spin-aware models outperform their scalar counterparts.

title: Constraining Dust Properties Along the Minor Axis of Andromeda
background_knowledge:
星际介质中的尘埃通过吸收恒星紫外与可见光，并在红外至亚毫米波段再辐射，是研究气尘介质、能量平衡和恒星形成的重要示踪物。在光学薄近似下，热尘埃发射常写为 $S_
u \propto B_
u(T_{m dust})\,\kappa_
u$，其中 $B_
u$ 为黑体函数，$T_{m dust}$ 为尘埃温度，$\kappa_
u \propto 
u^ eta$ 为尘埃不透明度，$ eta$ 为尘埃发射率指数。$ eta$ 对尘埃颗粒成分、尺寸分布、温度及加热历史敏感，是理解尘埃物理和校准远红外至亚毫米观测的关键参数。然而，用修正黑体拟合光谱能量分布时，$T_{m dust}$ 与 $ eta$ 常存在强简并；仅依赖远红外数据时，不同拟合可给出相近光谱但差异明显的 $T_{m dust}$、$ eta$。扩展至毫米波段可更好地采样瑞利—金斯尾部，从而缓解简并。M31 作为最近的旋涡星系，可在数十秒差距尺度分辨其尘埃结构，是检验尘埃性质径向变化和巨分子云（GMC）尺度物理的理想实验室。
contribution: 论文利用 IRAM 30 m NIKA2 对 M31 短轴方向开展 1.15 mm 成像，角分辨率为 11 arcsec，对应 M31 距离下约 40 pc；并将其与 Herschel 及 JCMT SCUBA-2 图联合，进行逐像素单成分修正黑体拟合。**加入 850 $\mu$m 与 1.15 mm 数据可有效降低 $T_{\rm dust}$–$\beta$ 简并，得到平均发射率指数 $\beta \approx 1.8$，系统性低于仅用远红外分析的结果。** 径向分析显示，**5 kpc 环中的 $\beta$ 高于 10 kpc 环**；内区 5 kpc 的较高 $\beta$ 可能与尘埃成分变化有关，并可能受到增强的星光加热影响。作者指出，**毫米波段覆盖对改进 M31 的 $\beta$ 限制十分重要**；由 250–1150 $\mu$m 光谱能量分布拟合得到的较低 $\beta$ 暗示尘埃发射率可能存在空间变化，也凸显在近邻星系中采样长波长 SED 斜率的重要性。
summary: Previous studies of dust emission in M31 based primarily on Herschel data have reported inconsistent radial trends in the dust emissivity index ($β$), partly due to limited wavelength coverage and the intrinsic $T_{\rm dust}$-$β$ degeneracy. We aim to improve the constraints of $β$ determinations and obtain the spatial surface density and temperature distributions at GMC scales in M31 by extending the spectral coverage into the millimeter regime and by quantifying the impact of wavelength coverage on the $T_{\rm dust}$-$β$ degeneracy. We present new IRAM 30m NIKA2 1.15 mm observations along the minor axis of M31 at an angular resolution of 11 arcsec, corresponding to $\sim 40$ pc at the distance of M31. These data are used with Herschel and JCMT SCUBA-2 maps to perform pixel-by-pixel single-component modified blackbody fitting. Including the 850 $μ$m and 1.15 mm data helps reduce the $T_{\rm dust}$-$β$ degeneracy and yields an average emissivity index of $β\approx 1.8$, systematically lower than values derived from far-infrared-only analyses. Radial analysis shows higher $β$ values in the 5 kpc ring compared to the 10 kpc ring. The elevated $β$ values in the inner 5 kpc may be linked to changes in dust composition, potentially associated with enhanced starlight heating in this region. Millimeter wavelength coverage is important for improving $β$ constraints in M31. The lower $β$ values inferred from the 250--1150 $μ$m SED fitting suggest possible variations in dust emissivity and highlight the importance of sampling the long-wavelength SED slope in nearby galaxies.

title: Measuring the gas mass of the protoplanetary disk around HD 179218 with CO isotopologues
background_knowledge: 原行星盘是年轻恒星周围由气体和尘埃组成、正在形成行星的旋转盘。其气体质量决定盘演化、行星形成效率和引力稳定性，但直接测量很难，因为主要质量成分是冷的分子氢，而 H$_2$ 在低温下缺乏可观测的偶极跃迁。天文学家常以 CO 及其同位素（$^{13}$CO、C$^{18}$O、C$^{17}$O）的毫米/亚毫米波谱线作为气体示踪剂，并通过辐射转移与热化学模型推断气体质量。该方法的关键假设是 CO 仍主要处于气相；然而在较冷盘中，CO 会在“CO 冻结线”以外冻结到尘埃表面，随后参与化学加工，导致基于 CO 的质量估计偏低。尘埃质量则可由毫米连续谱和谱能量分布拟合得到，再与气体质量比较，得到气体-to-尘埃比。典型星际介质值约为 100，原行星盘中的偏离可反映尘埃生长、径向漂移、气体耗散或光致蒸发等过程。Herbig 星周围的高光度盘可把 CO 冻结线推到盘外，从而提供检验 CO 质量测量可靠性的理想实验室。ALMA 与 NOEMA 的干涉观测、DALI 等热化学代码以及尘埃连续谱建模，是研究盘内气体分布、尘埃演化与气-尘相互作用的核心手段。
contribution: 论文利用 ALMA 和 NOEMA 对明亮 Herbig 星 HD 179218（$L_* \sim 100\,L_\odot$，$M_* \sim 3.0\,M_\odot$）周围原行星盘开展六个 CO 同位素谱线观测，包括 $^{13}$CO、C$^{18}$O 和 C$^{17}$O 的 $J=2$--$1$ 与 $J=1$--$0$ 跃迁。由于该盘的 CO 冻结线位于盘外缘之外，CO 在整个盘中保持气相，为检验基于 CO 的气体质量测量提供了罕见基准。通过拟合谱能量分布，作者得到尘埃质量 $M_{\rm dust} \approx 3 \times 10^{-5}\,M_\odot$；再用热化学代码 DALI 建模 CO 同位素发射，得到气体盘特征半径 $R_c \approx 90$ au 和气体质量 $M_{\rm gas} \approx 8 \times 10^{-3}\,M_\odot$。由此得到在基准尘埃不透明度（$a_{\rm max}=1$ mm）下的气体-to-尘埃比约为 270，**高于典型星际介质值约 100**。最佳拟合模型的热结构确认该盘中 CO 从未冻结，因此**这一升高比值并非 CO 耗竭造成的假象**；结合毫米尘埃盘相对于气体盘更为紧凑，其结果**与毫米尘埃显著向内径向漂移相一致**。此外，作者发现 50 au 以内存在一个气体空洞，其中包裹着紧凑的毫米尘埃盘——这与典型过渡盘相反——并**将其归因于卵石向内漂移后内区气体的光致蒸发清除**。HD 179218 因而为研究原行星盘气体质量分布和气-尘相互作用提供了一个不受冷盘 CO 耗竭偏差影响的干净基准。
summary: Carbon monoxide (CO) isotopologues are widely used to estimate protoplanetary disk gas masses, but their reliability is often compromised by CO freeze-out and subsequent chemical processing. The disk around the luminous Herbig star HD~179218 ($L_* \sim 100\,L_\odot$, $M_* \sim 3.0\,M_\odot$) offers a rare test case of CO-based mass measurements. Its CO snowline lies beyond the outer disk edge, and thus CO remains in the gas phase throughout. We present ALMA and NOEMA observations of six CO isotopologue lines ($^{13}$CO, C$^{18}$O, and C$^{17}$O, $J$=2--1 and 1--0). Fitting the spectral energy distribution yields $M_{dust} \approx 3 \times 10^{-5}\, M_\odot$. Modeling CO isotopologue emission with the thermochemical code DALI yields the gas-disk characteristic radius ($R_{c} \approx 90$~au) and the gas mass ($M_{gas} \approx 8 \times 10^{-3}\, M_\odot$). These results yield a gas-to-dust ratio of $\sim$270 for our fiducial dust opacity ($a_{\rm max} = 1$~mm), above the canonical interstellar value of $\sim$100. The thermal structure of our best-fitting model confirms that CO never freezes out in this disk, so the elevated ratio is not an artifact of CO depletion; together with the compact millimeter dust disk relative to the gas disk, it is consistent with substantial inward radial drift of millimeter dust. In addition, we find a gas cavity inside 50\,au that encloses the compact millimeter dust disk---the inverse of a typical transition disk---which we attribute to photoevaporative clearing of the inner gas after the pebbles drifted inward. HD~179218 thus provides a clean benchmark for studying the gas mass distribution and gas--dust interaction in protoplanetary disks, free from the CO-depletion biases that affect colder disks.

title: Galactic-Scale Distribution of 10Be and Its Implications for the Early Solar System 10Be/9Be
background_knowledge: 短寿命放射性核素是理解太阳系形成环境与时间尺度的关键示踪物。$^{10}\mathrm{Be}$ 半衰期约 1.4 Myr，主要由高能宇宙线与星际介质中的碳、氮、氧等原子核发生散裂反应产生；其稳定同位素 $^{9}\mathrm{Be}$ 则主要来自宇宙线散裂与恒星过程。陨石包体中的 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}/^{9}\mathrm{Be}$ 异常高，说明早期太阳系曾存在大量 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$。它究竟继承自母分子云，还是由早期太阳附近的局部辐照或晚期注入产生，是太阳系形成研究中的核心问题。银河系宇宙线在超新星遗迹中加速，并在多相星际介质中传播；新生恒星从分子云中形成，因此其初始放射性核素丰度取决于宇宙线能量密度、传播扩散、星际介质相结构以及恒星形成位置的联合分布。传统单区化学演化模型难以刻画这些三维、非均匀效应。
contribution: 论文首次开展银河系盘三维模拟，同时跟踪多相星际介质、宇宙线以及由银河系宇宙线和超新星遗迹产生并输运的 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$。结果表明，**几乎所有 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$ 都由银河系宇宙线相互作用产生，超新星遗迹对新形成恒星所继承 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$ 的贡献至多约 10%**。$^{10}\mathrm{Be}/^{9}\mathrm{Be}$ 比值追踪宇宙线能量密度，并随银心距平滑下降；由于恒星形成于超新星注入宇宙线较强的区域，其诞生气体中的宇宙线能量密度相对平均星际介质约高五倍，而单区估计会遗漏这一效应。考虑约 4.6 Gyr 前更高的银河系恒星形成率后，模型显示**继承银河系宇宙线产生的 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$ 即可解释早期太阳系的 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}/^{9}\mathrm{Be}$，无需晚期注入或局部辐照**。即使把致密气体中宇宙线诱导的 $^{10}\mathrm{Be}$ 产额降低十倍，陨石值仍可在最内侧银盘达到，其他区域仅差数倍，因此主要结论对低能宇宙线穿透的不确定性稳健。模型推断的太阳诞生半径强烈依赖宇宙线扩散率，范围为 3–8 kpc，表明改进低能宇宙线输运建模有望收紧对太阳系诞生地的约束。
summary: Meteoritic inclusions indicate that the early Solar System contained a substantial abundance of the short-lived radionuclide 10Be. Whether it was inherited from the parent molecular cloud or requires local irradiation or late injection remains debated. Here we present the first three-dimensional simulations of a Milky Way-like disc that follow the multi-phase interstellar medium, cosmic rays (CRs), and the production and transport of 10Be by galactic CRs (GCRs) and in supernova remnants (SNRs). Nearly all 10Be is produced by GCR interactions; SNRs contribute at most about ten percent of the 10Be inherited by newly formed stars. The 10Be/9Be ratio traces the CR energy density, declining smoothly with galactocentric radius, and because stars form where supernovae inject CRs, their natal gas is CR-enriched roughly fivefold relative to the mean interstellar medium, which one-zone estimates miss. Accounting for a possibly higher Galactic star formation rate 4.6 Gyr ago, inheritance of GCR-produced 10Be can then explain the early Solar System's 10Be/9Be in our models, without late injection or local irradiation. Even when GCR-induced 10Be production in dense gas is reduced tenfold, the meteoritic value is reached in the innermost disc and missed by only a factor of a few elsewhere, so the main conclusion is robust to uncertain low-energy GCR penetration. The inferred birth radius of the Sun depends strongly on the CR diffusivity, ranging between 3 and 8 kpc, suggesting that improved modelling of low-energy CR transport could sharpen constraints on the birthplace of the Solar System.

title: Multimessenger astrophysics drives the case for an Australian Gravitational-Wave observatory
background_knowledge: 引力波是加速运动的大质量天体在时空中激发的涟漪。2015 年 LIGO 首次直接探测到双黑洞并合产生的引力波，开启了引力波天文学。多信使天文学则强调将引力波与电磁波、中微子、宇宙线等不同信使联合观测，以更完整地理解极端天体物理过程；GW170817 双中子星并合及其伴随千新星是多信使天文学的里程碑。全球引力波观测网络依靠多台探测器的到达时间差与天线响应进行三角定位，台址的地理分布会直接影响天区定位精度和后续电磁随访效率。第二代地面探测器已运行，第三代及 XG 网络正规划中；澳大利亚位于南半球，具有独特的地理经度和观测条件，可在全球网络中对天区定位和快速联合观测发挥重要作用。
contribution: 论文面向下一代国际引力波观测网络的规划，结合澳大利亚在引力波研究、SKA 等大科学工程方面的基础及独特地理条件，论证其候选台址的科学价值，并重点分析其对多信使天文学的贡献。研究指出，澳大利亚台址有助于减小引力波事件的天区定位不确定度；在第二代和第三代全球网络配置下，最多每年可探测 **8 个引力波与千新星联合的多信使事件**，定位精度优于 $1-10\,\mathrm{deg}^{2}$。研究还表明，在全球 XG 观测网络中加入具有 2G 灵敏度的澳大利亚天文台，仍可 **显著推动多信使科学**。作者强调完整选址论证需置于更广泛背景中考虑，但本工作表明澳大利亚天文台 **有望对多信使天体物理作出实质性贡献**。
summary: The next generation of an international network of gravitational-wave observatories is now in the advanced planning stages.
